normal.desc: 【時態】The committee ___ the proposed tax reforms for three hours without reaching a consensus.
options: A. discusses
B. has been discussing
C. is discussed
D. had discussed
normal.explain: 句中有「for three hours」強調動作持續進行且尚未結束，符合現在完成進行式的使用時機。

normal.desc: 【被動語態】The controversial policy ___ by the board of directors during next month's meeting.
options: A. expects to review
B. is expecting to review
C. is expected to be reviewed
D. has expected to review
normal.explain: 政策是「被預期將被審查」，需使用「is expected to be + V-p.p.」的複雜被動語態。

normal.desc: 【推測語氣】The CEO's flight was delayed by a severe storm, so she ___ the opening speech.
options: A. must have missed
B. should miss
C. can be missing
D. ought to have missed
normal.explain: 基於班機延誤的事實，對過去發生的事情作肯定推測，應使用「must have + V-p.p.」，表示「一定已經錯過了」。

normal.desc: 【字彙】To ___ the financial burden on small businesses, the government introduced a new subsidy program.
options: A. aggravate
B. alleviate
C. allocate
D. alternate
normal.explain: alleviate 意為「減輕、緩和」。政府推動補助計畫是為了減輕小型企業的財務負擔。

normal.desc: 【時態】Scientists ___ this rare phenomenon since 2015, yet its true origin remains a mystery.
options: A. investigate
B. investigated
C. have been investigating
D. are investigating
normal.explain: 「since 2015」加上現在式「remains」，表示動作從過去持續到現在，應選現在完成進行式。

normal.desc: 【被動語態】The latest software update ___ to have caused several system crashes across the network.
options: A. believes
B. is believing
C. is believed
D. has believed
normal.explain: 「被認為」造成了當機，主詞是軟體更新，應使用被動語態 is believed (to have + V-p.p.)。

normal.desc: 【推測語氣】There was no forced entry, meaning the thief ___ a key to open the safe.
options: A. might use
B. must have used
C. will have used
D. could use
normal.explain: 沒有強行破壞的痕跡，代表小偷過去「一定使用了」鑰匙，這是有強烈依據的過去推測。

normal.desc: 【字彙】The board reached a ___ after hours of intense negotiation regarding the merger.
options: A. consensus
B. conflict
C. consequence
D. concept
normal.explain: consensus 意為「共識」。經過數小時談判後，董事會終於達成共識。

normal.desc: 【短文】Memo: The upcoming quarterly report is currently being drafted by the finance team. It is expected to be finalized by Friday. Since we have been experiencing a substantial deficit, all department heads must have prepared their cost-cutting strategies prior to the meeting. Q: What is implied about the company's financial status?
options: A. It is generating record-breaking profits.
B. It has been losing money recently.
C. It is expanding into new markets.
D. It has finalized its budget for next year.
normal.explain: 短文中提到「experiencing a substantial deficit」（經歷大幅虧損），因此暗示公司最近在賠錢。

normal.desc: 【短文】Science Daily: Researchers have been attempting to replicate the results of the groundbreaking study on renewable energy for months. However, the initial findings are now believed to have been skewed by equipment malfunction. Q: Why are the initial findings questionable?
options: A. The researchers lacked sufficient funding.
B. The data was deliberately falsified.
C. A flaw in the machinery likely affected the results.
D. The study was not published in a reputable journal.
normal.explain: 文章指出初步結果被認為是受到設備故障（equipment malfunction）的影響（skewed），故選 C。

normal.desc: 【時態】Our competitors ___ aggressively in artificial intelligence for the past few years to gain market share.
options: A. have been investing
B. are invested
C. invest
D. will invest
normal.explain: for the past few years 表示動作的持續性，需使用現在完成進行式。

normal.desc: 【被動語態】The new regulations are rumored ___ next week, although official confirmation is still pending.
options: A. to announce
B. to be announced
C. announcing
D. announced
normal.explain: be rumored to be + V-p.p. 表示「據傳將被...」，法規是被公布的對象。

normal.desc: 【推測語氣】You submitted the report without the financial attachments; you ___ them in your hurry.
options: A. must overlook
B. must have overlooked
C. should have overlooked
D. can overlook
normal.explain: 對於過去發生的失誤進行高度肯定的推測，「你當時一定是忽略了」，用 must have + V-p.p.。

normal.desc: 【字彙】The CEO's sudden resignation was completely ___; no one in the company saw it coming.
options: A. unprecedented
B. unresolved
C. undeniable
D. unexpected
normal.explain: unexpected 意為「出乎意料的」。沒有人預見這件事，代表它是未預期的。

normal.desc: 【時態】The environmental group ___ for stricter carbon emission laws long before the recent climate summit.
options: A. has been advocating
B. is advocating
C. had been advocating
D. will advocate
normal.explain: 在「過去的」氣候高峰會之前，就一直持續在倡議，屬於過去完成進行式的使用情境（比過去更早並持續）。若為現在完成進行式，後半句通常配合現在式。

normal.desc: 【被動語態】The ancient manuscript ___ to have been written by a renowned scholar in the 12th century.
options: A. thought
B. is thinking
C. has thought
D. is thought
normal.explain: 手稿「被認為」寫於12世紀，需用被動語態 is thought (to have been written)。

normal.desc: 【推測語氣】The sales figures are incredibly low this quarter. The marketing campaign ___ a total failure.
options: A. must have been
B. should be
C. would have been
D. could be
normal.explain: 基於銷售額極低的強烈證據，推測過去的行銷活動「一定是」徹底失敗了。

normal.desc: 【字彙】To remain competitive, the corporation must ___ substantial resources into research and development.
options: A. allocate
B. aggregate
C. alleviate
D. alienate
normal.explain: allocate 意為「分配、撥出」。公司必須分配資源到研發部門。

normal.desc: 【短文】Case Study: TechNova Inc. has been struggling with employee retention for two years. Industry analysts speculate that the rigid corporate culture must have driven top talent away. To combat this, flexible working hours are expected to be implemented next quarter. Q: What is the proposed solution to TechNova's problem?
options: A. Changing the corporate culture to be more strict.
B. Hiring more industry analysts.
C. Introducing flexible working schedules.
D. Increasing the salary of top talent.
normal.explain: 文章最後提到「flexible working hours are expected to be implemented」（預計實施彈性工時）以解決問題。

normal.desc: 【短文】Policy Brief: The new healthcare reform aims to alleviate the burden on public hospitals. It is widely acknowledged to have been drafted by a coalition of medical experts. However, critics argue that the policy is fundamentally flawed. Q: Who is believed to be the author of the reform?
options: A. Critics and politicians.
B. Public hospital administrators.
C. A group of medical experts.
D. The general public.
normal.explain: 文中指出「It is widely acknowledged to have been drafted by a coalition of medical experts」（公認由醫學專家聯盟起草）。

normal.desc: 【時態】The construction crew ___ on the new bridge since early this morning, despite the heavy rain.
options: A. worked
B. have been working
C. had worked
D. are worked
normal.explain: 「since early this morning」表示從今天早上持續到現在，用現在完成進行式。

normal.desc: 【被動語態】The confidential documents are reported ___ from the executive's office last night.
options: A. to steal
B. to be stealing
C. to have been stolen
D. stolen
normal.explain: 報導現在發生（are reported），但失竊發生在昨晚，需用 to have been stolen 表達過去完成的被動概念。

normal.desc: 【推測語氣】You walked right past me without saying hello; you ___ daydreaming.
options: A. might be
B. must have been
C. should have been
D. ought to be
normal.explain: 你走過去都沒打招呼，所以過去那個當下你「一定是在」做白日夢。must have been + V-ing。

normal.desc: 【字彙】The manager's ___ to compromise led to the collapse of the trade negotiations.
options: A. willingness
B. reluctance
C. capacity
D. tendency
normal.explain: reluctance 意為「不情願」。經理不願妥協，導致談判破裂。

normal.desc: 【時態】Inflation ___ steadily over the past six months, causing widespread concern among consumers.
options: A. is rising
B. rose
C. has been rising
D. will rise
normal.explain: over the past six months 表達這半年來不斷進行的趨勢，選現在完成進行式。

normal.desc: 【被動語態】The rare artifacts ___ to have been buried during a massive volcanic eruption.
options: A. presume
B. are presumed
C. have presumed
D. are presuming
normal.explain: 文物「被推定」掩埋於火山爆發，文物是受詞，需用被動語態 are presumed。

normal.desc: 【推測語氣】The streets are completely flooded this morning. It ___ heavily last night.
options: A. must have rained
B. should have rained
C. can rain
D. would have rained
normal.explain: 看到早上淹水的結果，推測昨晚「一定」下了大雨，用 must have + V-p.p.。

normal.desc: 【字彙】The startup's innovative approach has severely ___ the traditional banking industry.
options: A. disrupted
B. distributed
C. discarded
D. dissolved
normal.explain: disrupt 意為「擾亂、顛覆」。新創公司的做法顛覆了傳統銀行業。

normal.desc: 【短文】Editorial: The mayor's decision to cut public transit funding is fundamentally flawed. Citizens have been complaining about service delays for months. This disastrous policy is guaranteed to be met with fierce protests. The administration must have severely underestimated the public's reliance on buses and trains. Q: What is the author's attitude toward the mayor's decision?
options: A. Highly supportive and optimistic.
B. Critical and condemnatory.
C. Indifferent and neutral.
D. Confused and seeking clarification.
normal.explain: 作者使用了 fundamentally flawed (根本上有缺陷), disastrous policy (災難性政策) 等詞彙，顯示其態度為強烈批評(Critical)。

normal.desc: 【短文】Email to Staff: We are pleased to announce that the software migration is scheduled to be completed this weekend. Our IT team has been working tirelessly to ensure a smooth transition. If you experience any login issues on Monday, your account credentials might have been reset automatically. Q: What should an employee do if they cannot log in on Monday?
options: A. Contact the IT team immediately.
B. Wait for the software migration to finish.
C. Assume their password was reset automatically.
D. Complain about the transition process.
normal.explain: 信件中提到如果週一遇到登入問題，憑證可能是被自動重設了 (might have been reset automatically)。

normal.desc: 【時態】The legal team ___ the contract details meticulously since the dispute arose.
options: A. examines
B. has been examining
C. had examined
D. will be examining
normal.explain: 「since」引導的時間起點搭配「has been examining」，強調動作一直持續。

normal.desc: 【被動語態】The new marketing strategy is considered ___ extremely successful in boosting sales.
options: A. to be
B. being
C. to have been
D. having been
normal.explain: 被認為（現在）在提升銷量上非常成功（過去的成果），用 to have been。

normal.desc: 【推測語氣】You left your umbrella at the office; you ___ drenched in that sudden downpour.
options: A. must get
B. must have gotten
C. should have gotten
D. can get
normal.explain: 對過去已經發生的事情作推測，「你當時一定淋濕了」，用 must have gotten。

normal.desc: 【字彙】The company's primary ___ is to expand its operations into the European market by next year.
options: A. obstacle
B. objective
C. obligation
D. objection
normal.explain: objective 意為「目標」。公司的主要目標是拓展歐洲市場。

normal.desc: 【時態】Global temperatures ___ at an alarming rate, prompting immediate calls for climate action.
options: A. fluctuate
B. have been fluctuating
C. fluctuated
D. will fluctuate
normal.explain: 描述近期不斷進行並持續中的變化趨勢，使用現在完成進行式最恰當。

normal.desc: 【被動語態】The summit is scheduled ___ in Geneva, though the exact venue is yet to be confirmed.
options: A. to hold
B. to be held
C. holding
D. held
normal.explain: 高峰會是「被舉辦」，因此在 scheduled 後方接不定詞的被動形式 to be held。

normal.desc: 【推測語氣】The presentation slides are full of errors. He ___ them at the very last minute.
options: A. must prepare
B. might prepare
C. must have prepared
D. should prepare
normal.explain: 簡報充滿錯誤，強烈推測他過去「一定是在最後一刻才準備的」，用 must have + V-p.p.。

normal.desc: 【字彙】In order to finalize the deal, both parties must be willing to make ___.
options: A. concessions
B. confessions
C. conversions
D. conclusions
normal.explain: concession 意為「讓步」。雙方必須願意做出讓步才能完成交易。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
normal.speak: The risks are expected to be mitigated by the new system.
options: A. 預期新系統能減輕風險。
B. 預期新系統會增加整體成本。
C. 新系統已經消除了所有危險。
D. 風險是由新系統所造成的。
normal.explain: The risks are expected to be mitigated by the new system. (預期新系統能減輕風險。) mitigate 意指「減輕」；此處使用複雜被動語態 (are expected to be mitigated)。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
normal.speak: The accountant must have noticed the discrepancy in the report.
options: A. 會計師忽略了報告中的細節。
B. 會計師一定注意到了報告中的差異。
C. 會計師負責編寫這份差異報告。
D. 會計師要求修正所有的數字。
normal.explain: The accountant must have noticed the discrepancy in the report. (會計師一定注意到了報告中的差異。) discrepancy 指「不一致、差異」；must have noticed 為情態動詞推測過去發生之事。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
normal.speak: We have been implementing the updated guidelines all morning.
options: A. 我們早上才剛開始閱讀新指南。
B. 新指南將在明天早上生效。
C. 我們整個早上都在實施更新後的指南。
D. 我們已經放棄實施這些新指南。
normal.explain: We have been implementing the updated guidelines all morning. (我們整個早上都在實施更新後的指南。) implement 指「實施、執行」；此處為現在完成進行式，強調動作持續。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
normal.speak: A tentative schedule has been drafted by the board of directors.
options: A. 董事會已經取消了行程。
B. 董事會拒絕了這份草案。
C. 最終的行程表已經確認發布。
D. 董事會已經起草了一份暫定行程。
normal.explain: A tentative schedule has been drafted by the board of directors. (董事會已經起草了一份暫定行程。) tentative 指「暫時的、未定的」；has been drafted 是現在完成式的被動語態。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
normal.speak: The exclusive contract must have been extremely lucrative.
options: A. 份獨家合約利潤一定非常豐厚。
B. 這份合約一定是無效的。
C. 簽訂這份合約帶來了巨大的風險。
D. 他們肯定拒絕了這份有利可圖的合約。
normal.explain: The exclusive contract must have been extremely lucrative. (這份獨家合約利潤一定非常豐厚。) lucrative 指「賺錢的、有利可圖的」；must have been 表對過去狀態的肯定推測。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
normal.speak: The annual budget is being subjected to intense public scrutiny.
options: A. 年度預算已獲得公眾一致通過。
B. 年度預算正受到大眾嚴格的審查。
C. 大眾對預算的分配毫無興趣。
D. 預算審查已經在去年秘密完成。
normal.explain: The annual budget is being subjected to intense public scrutiny. (年度預算正受到大眾嚴格的審查。) scrutiny 指「仔細審查」；is being subjected to 為現在進行被動語態。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
normal.speak: The analysts have been compiling the survey results since Monday.
options: A. 分析師在週一前就完成了調查。
B. 分析師預計在週一開始編譯數據。
C. 分析師從週一開始就一直在彙編調查結果。
D. 調查結果在週一被全數銷毀。
normal.explain: The analysts have been compiling the survey results since Monday. (分析師從週一開始就一直在彙編調查結果。) compile 指「彙編、收集」；搭配現在完成進行式，表示從過去持續到現在。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
normal.speak: A special committee has been convened to discuss the merger.
options: A. 委員會已經解散並拒絕討論合併。
B. 委員會的決議導致了合併失敗。
C. 合併案已經不需要委員會來討論。
D. 已經召集了一個特別委員會來討論合併案。
normal.explain: A special committee has been convened to discuss the merger. (已經召集了一個特別委員會來討論合併案。) convene 指「召集、開會」；使用現在完成式的被動語態。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
normal.speak: They must have received a substantial bonus for that project.
options: A. 他們那個專案一定拿到了豐厚的獎金。
B. 他們的專案獎金被大幅削減了。
C. 他們必須為專案支付巨額罰款。
D. 專案的獎金微乎其微。
normal.explain: They must have received a substantial bonus for that project. (他們那個專案一定拿到了豐厚的獎金。) substantial 指「大量的、實質的」；must have received 表示對過去的強烈推測。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
normal.speak: The potential repercussions are being evaluated by the legal team.
options: A. 法律團隊拒絕評估任何風險。
B. 法律團隊正在評估潛在的不良影響。
C. 潛在的影響已經完全消除。
D. 法律團隊造成了嚴重的後果。
normal.explain: The potential repercussions are being evaluated by the legal team. (法律團隊正在評估潛在的不良影響。) repercussion 指「負面影響、後果」；此處為現在進行被動語態。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
normal.speak: The manager has been delegating tasks to the junior staff.
options: A. 經理拒絕將工作交給資淺員工。
B. 經理已經完成了所有資淺員工的任務。
C. 經理一直把任務委派給初級員工。
D. 初級員工一直在指導經理。
normal.explain: The manager has been delegating tasks to the junior staff. (經理一直把任務委派給初級員工。) delegate 指「委派、授權」；使用現在完成進行式強調動作的持續性。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
normal.speak: Small businesses are expected to be exempted from the new tax law.
options: A. 預期小型企業將受到新稅法的嚴格審查。
B. 小型企業預計會被徵收更高的稅。
C. 新稅法將完全由小型企業承擔。
D. 預期小型企業將被豁免於新稅法。
normal.explain: Small businesses are expected to be exempted from the new tax law. (預期小型企業將被豁免於新稅法。) exempt 指「免除、豁免」；句型使用了預期會發生某事的複雜被動語態。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
normal.speak: The CEO must have endorsed the proposal privately before the meeting.
options: A. 執行長一定在會議前私下背書了這項提案。
B. 執行長在會議上公開反對了這項提案。
C. 執行長根本沒有看過這份提案。
D. 執行長要求在會後重新評估提案。
normal.explain: The CEO must have endorsed the proposal privately before the meeting. (執行長一定在會議前私下背書了這項提案。) endorse 指「贊同、背書」；must have endorsed 推測過去發生的事。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
normal.speak: The stock market has been fluctuating wildly throughout this week.
options: A. 股市本週一直保持穩定。
B. 股市整個星期都在劇烈波動。
C. 股市已經連續一週停盤。
D. 本週股市呈現穩定上升的趨勢。
normal.explain: The stock market has been fluctuating wildly throughout this week. (股市整個星期都在劇烈波動。) fluctuate 指「波動、起伏」；現在完成進行式表達這週以來持續的狀態。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
normal.speak: The entire joint venture was nearly jeopardized by the sudden delay.
options: A. 突然的延誤使得合資企業大獲成功。
B. 合資企業完全沒有受到延誤的影響。
C. 整個合資企業幾乎因突然的延誤而面臨危險。
D. 延誤是由合資企業主動提出的。
normal.explain: The entire joint venture was nearly jeopardized by the sudden delay. (整個合資企業幾乎因突然的延誤而面臨危險。) jeopardize 指「危及、使受危險」；此處為被動語態表示受到威脅。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
normal.speak: The safety briefing has been made mandatory for all site visitors.
options: A. I prefer the optional tour, thanks.
B. The site is closed for renovation today.
C. Who is the mysterious visitor?
D. I'll make sure to attend it then.
normal.explain: The safety briefing has been made mandatory for all site visitors. (所有現場參觀者的安全簡報已改為強制性。) mandatory 指「強制的、必須的」；聽到強制性規定，回應「那我也一定會參加」最符合邏輯。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
normal.speak: We must have taken a more pragmatic approach to solve this.
options: A. 我們當時一定是採取了更務實的方法來解決這個問題。
B. 我們當時採取的方法太過理想化了。
C. 我們必須放棄所有務實的解決方案。
D. 這個方法完全無法解決我們的問題。
normal.explain: We must have taken a more pragmatic approach to solve this. (我們當時一定是採取了更務實的方法來解決這個問題。) pragmatic 意為「務實的」；must have taken 是對過去事實的肯定推斷。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
normal.speak: Stringent quality controls are being implemented as we speak.
options: A. Quality doesn't really matter to our clients.
B. That should help reduce the defect rate significantly.
C. Please control the volume of the speakers.
D. Speaking is strictly prohibited in the factory.
normal.explain: Stringent quality controls are being implemented as we speak. (嚴格的品質管控正此時此刻實施中。) stringent 指「嚴格的」；回應「這應能顯著降低不良率」符合職場對話邏輯。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
normal.speak: The team has been struggling to produce tangible results this quarter.
options: A. 團隊本季已經取得了巨大的成功。
B. 團隊拒絕分享他們的研究成果。
C. 團隊本季度一直難以產出具體的成果。
D. 團隊的成果非常抽象且難以理解。
normal.explain: The team has been struggling to produce tangible results this quarter. (團隊本季度一直難以產出具體的成果。) tangible 指「具體的、有形的」；has been struggling 顯示持續遭遇困難。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
normal.speak: The board's decision to expand overseas must have been unanimous.
options: A. They couldn't agree on a single location.
B. The expansion unfortunately failed last year.
C. It was a very narrow vote, actually.
D. Yes, everyone voted in favor of it without hesitation.
normal.explain: The board's decision to expand overseas must have been unanimous. (董事會向海外擴張的決定一定是一致通過的。) unanimous 指「全體一致的」；回應「是的，大家都毫不猶豫投了贊成票」最合理。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
normal.speak: Crucial evidence is believed to have been withheld from the public.
options: A. 據信有關鍵證據被對公眾隱瞞了。
B. 公眾已經交出了所有關鍵證據。
C. 關鍵證據已經完全公開透明化。
D. 根本沒有任何關鍵證據存在。
normal.explain: Crucial evidence is believed to have been withheld from the public. (據信有關鍵證據被對公眾隱瞞了。) withhold 指「保留、隱瞞」；is believed to have been 為複雜被動語態，表示「被認為已經...」。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
normal.speak: We have been complying with all the new industry regulations.
options: A. They are always breaking the law intentionally.
B. Good, that keeps us out of legal trouble.
C. Regulations are incredibly annoying to read.
D. Complaining won't help us finish the project.
normal.explain: We have been complying with all the new industry regulations. (我們一直遵守著所有新的行業法規。) comply (with) 指「遵守」；回應「很好，這能讓我們免於法律麻煩」最合適。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
normal.speak: The speaker's controversial comments must have elicited a strong reaction.
options: A. 演講者拒絕對評論發表任何回應。
B. 演講者的言論完全沒有引起注意。
C. 演講者具爭議的言論一定引起了強烈的反應。
D. 演講者強烈反對那些爭議性評論。
normal.explain: The speaker's controversial comments must have elicited a strong reaction. (演講者具爭議的言論一定引起了強烈的反應。) elicit 指「引出、誘出」；must have elicited 表示肯定的推測。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
normal.speak: A culture of open innovation is being fostered within the department.
options: A. The department is closing down next month.
B. The culture here is very traditional and strict.
C. Mr. Foster is not in the office today.
D. I've noticed people are sharing more creative ideas now.
normal.explain: A culture of open innovation is being fostered within the department. (部門內正在培養開放創新的文化。) foster 指「培養、促進」；回應「我注意到大家現在分享了更多創意點子」符合語境。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
normal.speak: Doubts about the company's financial health have been lingering for months.
options: A. 對公司財務狀況的疑慮這幾個月來一直揮之不去。
B. 公司在過去幾個月的財務狀況非常穩健。
C. 關於公司財務的疑慮已經在幾個月前消除了。
D. 公司每個月都會發布詳細的財務報告。
normal.explain: Doubts about the company's financial health have been lingering for months. (對公司財務狀況的疑慮這幾個月來一直揮之不去。) linger 指「逗留、徘徊不散」；現在完成進行式強調狀態的持續。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
normal.speak: The two regional departments are expected to be merged by next quarter.
options: A. They are splitting up into three smaller teams.
B. Will there be any staff layoffs as a result?
C. The first quarter ended yesterday.
D. The profit margins are simply too low right now.
normal.explain: The two regional departments are expected to be merged by next quarter. (這兩個地區部門預計在下季前合併。) merge 指「合併」；聽到部門合併，詢問「結果會導致裁員嗎？」是常見的職場反應。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
normal.speak: He must have relinquished his position on the board voluntarily.
options: A. 他是被迫離開董事會的。
B. 他一直堅守著董事會的職位。
C. 他一定自願放棄了他在董事會的職位。
D. 他剛剛被選入董事會。
normal.explain: He must have relinquished his position on the board voluntarily. (他一定自願放棄了他在董事會的職位。) relinquish 指「放棄、交出」；must have V-p.p. 用於強烈推測過去發生的事。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
normal.speak: Our quarterly sales have been surpassing all initial projections.
options: A. The sales are unfortunately dropping fast.
B. We need to try harder to meet the minimum quota.
C. Projections are usually completely useless anyway.
D. That's fantastic news for our long-term shareholders!
normal.explain: Our quarterly sales have been surpassing all initial projections. (我們的季度銷售額一直超越所有最初的預測。) surpass 指「超越」；聽到業績超標，回答「這對股東來說是極好的消息」最為貼切。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
normal.speak: The local startup ecosystem is said to have been thriving since the tax cuts.
options: A. 據說自從減稅以來，當地的新創生態系統一直蓬勃發展。
B. 減稅政策徹底摧毀了當地的新創生態系統。
C. 當地新創生態系統一直要求政府增加稅收。
D. 據說減稅對當地生態系統沒有任何影響。
normal.explain: The local startup ecosystem is said to have been thriving since the tax cuts. (據說自從減稅以來，當地的新創生態系統一直蓬勃發展。) thrive 指「繁榮、茁壯」；is said to have been... 是進階被動句型。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
normal.speak: Her authority as a manager must have been undermined by the recent scandal.
options: A. She was promoted to director very recently, actually.
B. Yes, people are openly questioning her leadership now.
C. The coal miners have been on strike for two weeks.
D. The scandal turned out to be completely fake.
normal.explain: Her authority as a manager must have been undermined by the recent scandal. (她身為經理的權威一定被最近的醜聞削弱了。) undermine 指「暗中破壞、削弱」；回應「是的，大家現在都在質疑她的領導能力」最合理。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
normal.speak: We have been allocating additional resources to the new branch all month.
options: A. Where exactly is the new branch located?
B. The new branch was permanently closed yesterday.
C. How much of the expansion budget is still left?
D. Allocation is definitely not needed at this stage.
normal.explain: We have been allocating additional resources to the new branch all month. (我們整個月份都在分配額外資源給新分公司。) allocate 指「分配、撥出」；回應詢問「擴張預算還剩多少？」延續了資源分配的話題。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
normal.speak: The election results are expected to be conceded by the opposition tonight.
options: A. 預期反對派會贏得今晚的選舉。
B. 選舉結果已被政府秘密隱瞞。
C. 今晚將全面重新計算所有選票。
D. 預期反對派今晚會承認敗選。
normal.explain: The election results are expected to be conceded by the opposition tonight. (預期反對派今晚會承認選舉結果／承認敗選。) concede 指「讓步、承認失敗」；常與選舉結果搭配。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
normal.speak: Consumer demand must have outstripped our supply much faster than anticipated.
options: A. Yes, we completely ran out of stock by Tuesday.
B. Consumer demand is incredibly low right now.
C. The global supply chain has been severely broken.
D. Fast overnight delivery is guaranteed for all orders.
normal.explain: Consumer demand must have outstripped our supply much faster than anticipated. (消費者的需求超過我們供應的速度一定比預期的快很多。) outstrip 指「超過、勝過」；回答「是的，我們星期二就完全缺貨了」符合情境。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
normal.speak: The financial issues we have been discussing pertain exclusively to the upcoming merger.
options: A. 我們討論的財務問題與合併完全無關。
B. 我們一直討論的財務問題僅與即將到來的合併有關。
C. 這些嚴重的財務問題已經導致合併案被取消。
D. 所有會議討論的問題都與公司財務無關。
normal.explain: The financial issues we have been discussing pertain exclusively to the upcoming merger. (我們一直討論的財務問題僅與即將到來的合併有關。) pertain to 指「關於、有關」；exclusively 意為「專門地」。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
normal.speak: The entire factory renovation process is being overseen by an external consultant.
options: A. I haven't seen the new factory layout yet.
B. Total renovation is simply too expensive for us.
C. I hope they have relevant industrial experience.
D. The external consultant was just fired yesterday.
normal.explain: The entire factory renovation process is being overseen by an external consultant. (整個工廠的翻新過程正由一位外部顧問監督。) oversee 指「監督、管理」；回應「希望他們有相關的工業經驗」很自然。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
normal.speak: The original employment contract must have stipulated a strict non-compete clause.
options: A. 原始合約沒有包含任何工作限制。
B. 員工今天必須簽署新的競業禁止條款。
C. 原始合約的各項條款一直被員工違反。
D. 原始僱傭合約一定規定了嚴格的競業禁止條款。
normal.explain: The original employment contract must have stipulated a strict non-compete clause. (原始僱傭合約一定規定了嚴格的競業禁止條款。) stipulate 指「規定、約定」；must have stipulated 是對合約內容的肯定推測。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
normal.speak: We have been searching for a commercially viable alternative to plastic packaging.
options: A. Have you found any promising biodegradable materials yet?
B. Plastic is absolutely the only option available to us.
C. The new television commercial was extremely successful.
D. We stopped searching for alternatives late last year.
normal.explain: We have been searching for a commercially viable alternative to plastic packaging. (我們一直在尋找商業上可行的塑膠包裝替代方案。) viable 指「可實行的、能存活的」；回應「你們有找到任何有潛力的生物可分解材料嗎？」最對題。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
normal.speak: The preliminary research findings have been heavily criticized by the scientific community.
options: A. 初步的研究結果受到了科學界的熱烈讚賞。
B. 初步的研究結果受到了科學界的嚴厲批評。
C. 科學界一致拒絕進行任何初步的研究調查。
D. 這項研究的結果已經是最終定案，無可更改。
normal.explain: The preliminary research findings have been heavily criticized by the scientific community. (初步的研究結果受到了科學界的嚴厲批評。) preliminary 指「初步的」；have been criticized 是現在完成式的被動語態。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
normal.speak: The latest quarterly figures must have been finalized by now.
options: A. 最新季度的數據現在應該已經定案了。
B. 我們現在必須完成最新季度的數據。
C. 最新季度的數據現在才剛開始計算。
D. 他們可能忘記確認最新季度的數據了。
normal.explain: 原句：The latest quarterly figures must have been finalized by now. 意思：最新季度的數據現在應該已經定案了。must have been finalized 表示對已發生狀態的肯定推測（應該已經被完成了）。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
normal.speak: We have been monitoring the server traffic since the product launch.
options: A. I will launch it tomorrow.
B. Have you noticed any unusual spikes?
C. The traffic light is still red.
D. It must have been a great product.
normal.explain: 原句：We have been monitoring the server traffic since the product launch.（自從產品發表後，我們一直在監控伺服器流量。）回應 B「你有注意到任何異常的流量高峰嗎？」最符合情境。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
normal.speak: The outpatient clinic's schedule is expected to be reorganized next month.
options: A. 門診部的時間表上個月已經重新安排了。
B. 門診部預計在下個月重新招募員工。
C. 門診部的時間表預計在下個月重新調整。
D. 門診部預期下個月會有更多病患。
normal.explain: 原句：The outpatient clinic's schedule is expected to be reorganized next month. 意思：門診部的時間表預計在下個月重新調整。is expected to be reorganized 為複雜被動語態。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
normal.speak: The blueprints must have been misplaced during the office relocation.
options: A. 藍圖在辦公室搬遷前就已經完成了。
B. 藍圖在辦公室搬遷期間一定是被放錯地方了。
C. 我們必須在搬遷期間把藍圖放好。
D. 辦公室搬遷時不應該攜帶藍圖。
normal.explain: 原句：The blueprints must have been misplaced during the office relocation. 意思：藍圖在辦公室搬遷期間一定是被放錯地方了。misplace 意指放錯地方而找不到。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
normal.speak: The new zoning regulations are currently being debated at the city hall.
options: A. I hope they reach a consensus soon.
B. The city hall is located downtown.
C. They must have built a new zone.
D. Yes, the debate was cancelled.
normal.explain: 原句：The new zoning regulations are currently being debated at the city hall.（新的分區法規目前正在市政廳進行辯論。）回應 A「我希望他們很快達成共識」最合理。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
normal.speak: Customer complaints have been escalating since the firmware update.
options: A. 自從韌體更新後，客訴量就在減少。

normal.desc: 【時態】The legal counsel ___ the proposed non-disclosure agreement for the past three weeks.
options: A. is reviewing
B. has been reviewing
C. had reviewed
D. reviews
normal.explain: 句尾有 for the past three weeks（過去三週以來），表示動作從過去持續到現在且可能還在進行，應使用現在完成進行式 (has been reviewing)。

normal.desc: 【被動語態】The amended privacy clause is expected ___ by the regulatory committee next Monday.
options: A. to approve
B. approving
C. to be approved
D. having approved
normal.explain: be expected to 後面接原形動詞。由於條款 (clause) 是被核准，因此要用被動的不定詞 (to be approved)。

normal.desc: 【推測語氣】The tenant breached the contract so easily; he ___ the penalty terms carefully.
options: A. must read
B. should read
C. cannot read
D. must not have read
normal.explain: 前半句指出租客輕易違約（發生在過去），推測他當時「一定沒有」仔細閱讀罰則，表對過去否定的強烈推測用 must not have V-en。

normal.desc: 【字彙】The new contract explicitly ___ that all intellectual property rights belong to the employer.
options: A. mitigates
B. stipulates
C. fluctuates
D. evokes
normal.explain: stipulate 意為「規定、明確要求」，符合合約規定權利的語境。mitigate (減輕)，fluctuate (波動)，evoke (喚起) 皆不合。

normal.desc: 【時態】We ___ on this trademark dispute since January. Unfortunately, the opposing party remains uncooperative.
options: A. work
B. are working
C. have been working
D. will work
normal.explain: since January 提示動作從一月持續至今，且強調「持續進行」的狀態，故選現在完成進行式 (have been working)。

normal.desc: 【被動語態】The intellectual property rights are widely assumed ___ to the original creator, despite the recent lawsuit.
options: A. to have been returned
B. to return
C. returning
D. having returned
normal.explain: 被廣泛認為 (are widely assumed) 的事情發生在過去，且權利是被歸還的，故使用 to have been + V-en 表達發生在過去的被動語態。

normal.desc: 【字彙】Failure to maintain ___ with the updated safety regulations will result in immediate legal action.
options: A. omission
B. compliance
C. resurgence
D. discrepancy
normal.explain: maintain compliance with 為固定搭配，意指「遵守...規定」。omission (遺漏)，resurgence (復甦)，discrepancy (差異) 語意不符。

normal.desc: 【時態】The HR department ___ employee feedback regarding the new remote work policy since its implementation.
options: A. has been gathering
B. will gather
C. is gathered
D. gathers
normal.explain: 有 since 加上過去的時間點 (its implementation)，表示從過去持續到現在的動作，選現在完成進行式。

normal.desc: 【被動語態】All unused vacation days are required ___ before the end of the fiscal year.
options: A. to claim
B. to be claimed
C. claiming
D. having claimed
normal.explain: require sth to be V-en，特休假 (vacation days) 是「被申請、被使用」的，所以必須用被動不定詞 to be claimed。

normal.desc: 【推測語氣】You didn't receive the mandatory training invite; the automated system ___ your email address.
options: A. should miss
B. will miss
C. must have missed
D. has to miss
normal.explain: 前半句事實為沒收到邀請（過去式），推測是系統漏掉了信箱。對過去事情的肯定推測用 must have V-en (一定漏掉了)。

normal.desc: 【字彙】Employees can ___ up to 15 days of paid time off per year, which will roll over to the next year if unused.
options: A. accrue
B. mitigate
C. overhaul
D. validate
normal.explain: accrue 意為「累積」，常與休假或利息搭配。mitigate (減輕)，overhaul (全面檢修)，validate (驗證)。

normal.desc: 【被動語態】The annual performance review process is scheduled ___ entirely to a digital platform by next quarter.
options: A. to be transitioned
B. transitioning
C. to transition
D. having transitioned
normal.explain: is scheduled 後接 to V，而審查流程是被轉移到數位平台，故選被動不定詞 to be transitioned。

normal.desc: 【字彙】If there is any ___ between your logged hours and your paycheck, please contact Human Resources immediately.
options: A. compliance
B. discrepancy
C. prerequisite
D. sustainability
normal.explain: discrepancy 意為「差異、不一致」，此處指紀錄工時與薪資單之間的出入。prerequisite (先決條件)。

normal.desc: 【時態】Researchers at the institute ___ the effects of microplastics on marine ecosystems for over a decade.
options: A. are investigated
B. investigate
C. have been investigating
D. to investigate
normal.explain: for over a decade 表示動作從過去持續了十多年至今，需用現在完成進行式。

normal.desc: 【被動語態】The experimental data is believed ___ by a sudden fluctuation in the laboratory's temperature yesterday.
options: A. to corrupt
B. to have been corrupted
C. corrupting
D. has corrupted
normal.explain: is believed (現在被認為)，但破壞數據發生在昨天(yesterday)，須用 to have V-en 表過去，且數據是被破壞，故選 to have been corrupted。

normal.desc: 【推測語氣】The control group showed identical results to the test group. The researchers ___ a crucial variable during the setup.
options: A. must have overlooked
B. should overlook
C. cannot overlook
D. might overlook
normal.explain: 兩組結果竟然一樣，推測研究人員當時「一定忽略了」某個關鍵變數。對過去事實的強烈推論用 must have V-en。

normal.desc: 【字彙】The core ___ of this study is that urban noise pollution significantly alters bird communication patterns.
options: A. omission
B. hypothesis
C. reimbursement
D. itinerary
normal.explain: hypothesis 意為「假設」，指研究的核心論點。omission (遺漏)，reimbursement (核銷/退款)，itinerary (行程)。

normal.desc: 【字彙】To ensure the study's reliability, the scientists had to ___ the collected data against multiple independent sources.
options: A. evoke
B. stipulate
C. validate
D. accrue
normal.explain: validate 意為「驗證、確認...的有效性」，符合確認數據可靠性的語境。evoke (喚起)，stipulate (規定)，accrue (累積)。

normal.desc: 【時態】Travel agencies ___ a sharp increase in bookings to eco-friendly destinations since the border restrictions were lifted.
options: A. were witnessed
B. have been witnessing
C. will witness
D. are witnessing
normal.explain: 自從邊境管制解除(since...)以來一直持續的現象，使用現在完成進行式 has/have been V-ing。

normal.desc: 【被動語態】The historic castle, which was heavily damaged by fire, is expected ___ to its former glory by 2028.
options: A. to be restored
B. restoring
C. to restore
D. having restored
normal.explain: is expected 後接 to V，城堡是「被修復」，故使用被動不定詞 to be restored。

normal.desc: 【推測語氣】The flight was completely overbooked by noon. The airline ___ more tickets than there were available seats.
options: A. could sell
B. must have sold
C. should sell
D. need to sell
normal.explain: 班機超賣是過去發生的事實，推論航空公司當時「一定賣了」超過座位的票，用 must have V-en。

normal.desc: 【字彙】After years of decline, the coastal town is experiencing a remarkable ___ in international tourism.
options: A. compliance
B. resurgence
C. discrepancy
D. exemption
normal.explain: resurgence 意為「復甦、再起」，符合經歷衰退後觀光業復甦的語境。exemption (豁免)。

normal.desc: 【字彙】Our customized ___ allows you to explore the local culture at your own pace without rushing through the attractions.
options: A. itinerary
B. omission
C. hypothesis
D. overhaul
normal.explain: itinerary 意為「行程表、旅行路線」，在旅遊情境中最為合理。overhaul (全面檢修)。

normal.desc: 【時態】Literary critics ___ the author's unconventional narrative style since her debut novel was published.
options: A. have been praising
B. praised
C. were praising
D. to praise
normal.explain: since her debut novel was published 標示了過去的起點，延續至今的動作應選現在完成進行式。

normal.desc: 【被動語態】The highly anticipated sequel is rumored ___ from the perspective of the original villain.
options: A. to have written
B. to be written
C. writing
D. writes
normal.explain: is rumored (被謠傳) 後接 to V，續集是「被寫成」，所以用 to be written。

normal.desc: 【推測語氣】The protagonist's sudden change of heart felt completely unearned. The editor ___ a crucial transitional chapter before publication.
options: A. must have deleted
B. must delete
C. should delete
D. can delete
normal.explain: 讀者感覺主角心境轉變太突兀，推測編輯在出版前「一定刪掉了」過渡章節。對過去強烈推論用 must have V-en。

normal.desc: 【字彙】The novelist's ability to create a truly ___ atmosphere keeps readers on the edge of their seats.
options: A. captivating
B. mandatory
C. preliminary
D. vulnerable
normal.explain: captivating 意為「迷人的、具吸引力的」，修飾氣氛最為恰當。mandatory (強制的)，preliminary (初步的)。

normal.desc: 【字彙】Despite its flaws, the book successfully manages to ___ a deep sense of nostalgia for a bygone era.
options: A. accrue
B. stipulate
C. evoke
D. mitigate
normal.explain: evoke 意為「喚起(記憶、情感)」，常與 nostalgia (鄉愁/懷舊感) 搭配。

normal.desc:
【對話】A: Have you reviewed the drafted policy?
B: Yes, but the new wording is confusing. The HR manager is believed ___ it without consulting the legal team.
Q: What belongs in the blank?
options: A. to have altered
B. to alter
C. altering
D. having altered
normal.explain: is believed (現在被認為)，而更改措辭是過去發生的事，且為人資經理主動更改，故用 to have altered。

normal.desc:
【對話】A: Why is the server down again?
B: The IT department ___ the system infrastructure all morning. It should be back online soon.
Q: What belongs in the blank?
options: A. are overhauling
B. has been overhauling
C. will overhaul
D. overhauls
normal.explain: all morning 強調從早上一直持續到現在的動作，使用現在完成進行式 has been overhauling (全面檢修)。

normal.desc: 【短文】Notice: The pool area has been undergoing maintenance. It is scheduled to be reopened next Monday. Q: What is the current status of the pool area?
options: A. It is ready for public use.
B. It is currently being repaired.
C. It will be closed permanently.
D. It was opened last Monday.
normal.explain: has been undergoing maintenance 表示一直在進行維修，對應 currently being repaired。

normal.desc: 【短文】Memo: The upcoming workshop is mandatory for all new hires. Anyone who misses it must submit a valid ___ request. Q: Which word fits the blank best?
options: A. exemption
B. compliance
C. itinerary
D. resurgence
normal.explain: mandatory (強制的)，如果缺席必須提交有效的「豁免 (exemption)」申請才合理。

normal.desc: 【時態】The financial analysts ___ the market trends rigorously to predict the next economic shift.
options: A. have been evaluating
B. evaluates
C. are evaluated
D. to evaluate
normal.explain: 分析師們持續進行評估的動作，以預測未來的變動，用現在完成進行式最符合語境與文法。

normal.desc: 【被動語態】The controversial employment regulations are confirmed ___ by the parliament during yesterday's session.
options: A. to be repealed
B. to have been repealed
C. repealing
D. have repealed
normal.explain: are confirmed 是現在式，但廢除 (repeal) 發生在 yesterday，且法規是被廢除的，需用完成式被動不定詞 to have been repealed。

normal.desc: 【推測語氣】You brought a heavy coat to the tropical island. You ___ the weather forecast correctly.
options: A. must read
B. should have read
C. must not have read
D. cannot read
normal.explain: 把厚外套帶去熱帶島嶼是不合理的，推測他過去「一定沒有」看對天氣預報，用 must not have V-en。

normal.desc: 【字彙】The CEO decided to ___ the two smaller departments into one streamlined division to cut costs.
options: A. mitigate
B. consolidate
C. stipulate
D. fluctuate
normal.explain: consolidate 意為「合併、統一」，符合把兩個小部門合併成一個的語意。

normal.desc: 【字彙】Offering remote work options has become a powerful ___ for attracting top talent in the tech industry.
options: A. omission
B. discrepancy
C. incentive
D. compliance
normal.explain: incentive 意為「誘因、動機」，提供遠端工作選項是吸引人才的誘因。

normal.desc: 【綜合】The documentary is widely considered ___ light on the overlooked contributions of female scientists. The director must have done extensive archival research.
options: A. to have shed
B. shedding
C. to shed
D. having shed
normal.explain: is widely considered (被廣泛認為)，而紀錄片揭露真相 (shed light on) 是過去已發生的成就，故用 to have shed。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
normal.speak: The complimentary upgrade must have been given to our frequent flyers.
options: A. 這些常客必須自己付費升等。
B. 航班因為常客太多而取消了。
C. 免費升等應該是給了我們的常客。
D. 升等的旅客必須出示會員卡。
normal.explain: 英文原句：The complimentary upgrade must have been given to our frequent flyers. (免費升等應該是給了我們的常客。) 句型 must have been + V-p.p. 表示對過去被動事實的肯定推測。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
normal.speak: We have been attempting to reroute your luggage since early this morning.
options: A. 你的行李從今天早上就一直被我們嘗試重新安排路線。
B. 我們早上已經把你的行李寄回去了。
C. 行李的運送路線必須在早上前確認。
D. 我們從早上就一直在等你的行李。
normal.explain: 英文原句：We have been attempting to reroute your luggage since early this morning. (你的行李從今天早上就一直被我們嘗試重新安排路線。) 使用現在完成進行式 have been V-ing 表達從過去持續到現在的動作。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
normal.speak: Your connecting flight is anticipated to be delayed by severe turbulence.
options: A. 你的轉機航班預計會準時起飛。
B. 你的轉機航班預期會因為嚴重亂流而延誤。
C. 亂流導致你的航班必須更改目的地。
D. 我們強烈建議你取消有亂流的轉機航班。
normal.explain: 英文原句：Your connecting flight is anticipated to be delayed by severe turbulence. (你的轉機航班預期會因為嚴重亂流而延誤。) is anticipated to be delayed 為複雜被動語態。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
normal.speak: The passengers must have felt stranded when the sudden cancellation was announced.
options: A. 乘客必須在宣布取消時離開機場。
B. 航班取消後，乘客被要求待在原地。
C. 當宣布突然取消時，乘客一定感到受困無援。
D. 乘客在取消前就已經覺得很疲憊了。
normal.explain: 英文原句：The passengers must have felt stranded when the sudden cancellation was announced. (當宣布突然取消時，乘客一定感到受困無援。) stranded 意為滯留的、無援的。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
normal.speak: All affected travelers have been receiving meal vouchers at the service counter.
options: A. 服務櫃檯將在稍後發放餐券。
B. 旅客必須到櫃檯購買餐券。
C. 所有受影響的旅客因為沒有餐券而在櫃檯抗議。
D. 所有受影響的旅客一直都在服務櫃檯領取餐券。
normal.explain: 英文原句：All affected travelers have been receiving meal vouchers at the service counter. (所有受影響的旅客一直都在服務櫃檯領取餐券。) have been receiving 強調動作持續進行中。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
normal.speak: A generous travel credit is expected to be issued to remedy the overbooking situation.
options: A. 超額預訂的情況預計會透過發放慷慨的旅遊金來補救。
B. 旅客預期會因為超額預訂而支付更多費用。
C. 旅遊金的發放導致了超額預訂的狀況。
D. 航空公司必須撤銷所有超額預訂的旅遊金。
normal.explain: 英文原句：A generous travel credit is expected to be issued to remedy the overbooking situation. (超額預訂的情況預計會透過發放慷慨的旅遊金來補救。) is expected to be issued 預計被發放。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
normal.speak: I have been waiting on hold for an agent for over forty minutes. Can someone assist me?
options: A. The flight will depart in forty minutes, please hurry.
B. I sincerely apologize for the wait. Let me pull up your reservation right away.
C. You must have been waiting at the wrong boarding gate.
D. The customer service agent has been promoted recently.
normal.explain: 對話情境：乘客抱怨已經在線上等了超過四十分鐘。選項 B「非常抱歉讓您久等，我馬上為您調出預訂資料」為最合適的客服回應。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
normal.speak: The VIP lounge access must have been revoked due to a system error.
options: A. 系統錯誤導致 VIP 貴賓室必須關閉。
B. VIP 貴賓室的使用權限一定是因系統錯誤而被撤銷了。
C. 旅客必須回報系統錯誤才能進入 VIP 貴賓室。
D. 貴賓室的系統錯誤目前已經被排除了。
normal.explain: 英文原句：The VIP lounge access must have been revoked due to a system error. (VIP 貴賓室的使用權限一定是因系統錯誤而被撤銷了。) revoke 意為撤銷、廢除。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
normal.speak: Our dedicated flight attendants have been demonstrating the emergency evacuation procedures.
options: A. 空服員正在要求乘客閱讀緊急疏散手冊。
B. 緊急疏散程序必須由機長親自示範。
C. 我們的空服員剛結束了緊急疏散演練。
D. 我們盡責的空服員一直在示範緊急疏散程序。
normal.explain: 英文原句：Our dedicated flight attendants have been demonstrating the emergency evacuation procedures. (我們盡責的空服員一直在示範緊急疏散程序。) have been V-ing 表示持續的動作。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
normal.speak: The boarding gate is believed to have been changed without any prior announcement.
options: A. 登機門被認為在沒有事先廣播的情況下就更改了。
B. 乘客相信登機門的廣播一定有提早宣布。
C. 航空公司必須在更改登機門前進行廣播。
D. 登機門的更改是因為之前的廣播出了問題。
normal.explain: 英文原句：The boarding gate is believed to have been changed without any prior announcement. (登機門被認為在沒有事先廣播的情況下就更改了。) is believed to have been changed 表示對過去事件的客觀推斷。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
normal.speak: The landlord has been reviewing the prospective tenant's background carefully.
options: A. 房東必須調查租客的家庭背景。
B. 房東一直在仔細審查潛在租客的背景資料。

normal.explain: 英文原句：The landlord has been reviewing the prospective tenant's background carefully. (房東一直在仔細審查潛在租客的背景資料。) prospective 意為潛在的、未來的。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
normal.speak: The final property appraisal must have been conducted by an independent agency.
options: A. 獨立機構必須拒絕這次的房產估價。

normal.explain: 英文原句：The final property appraisal must have been conducted by an independent agency. (最終的房產估價一定是交由獨立機構進行的。) appraisal 為估價、評估。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
normal.speak: We have been drafting a customized lease agreement for the new occupants.
options: A. 我們必須為新住戶修改租約。
B. 新住戶已經草擬好了他們的租賃協議。
C. 租賃協議的內容一直無法讓新住戶滿意。
D. 我們一直在為新住戶草擬一份客製化的租賃協議。
normal.explain: 英文原句：We have been drafting a customized lease agreement for the new occupants. (我們一直在為新住戶草擬一份客製化的租賃協議。) lease agreement 即租約。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
normal.speak: The down payment is required to be transferred into the escrow account.
options: A. 頭期款被要求匯入履約保證帳戶中。
B. 履約保證帳戶必須準備足夠的頭期款。
C. 頭期款的轉帳一定失敗了。
D. 銀行要求我們開設一個頭期款帳戶。
normal.explain: 英文原句：The down payment is required to be transferred into the escrow account. (頭期款被要求匯入履約保證帳戶中。) escrow account 為第三方託管帳戶/履保帳戶。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
normal.speak: They must have secured a favorable mortgage rate before the market shifted.
options: A. 在市場轉變前，他們必須去申請抵押貸款。
B. 他們在市場變化前，一定已經爭取到優惠的房貸利率了。
C. 市場轉變導致他們的房貸利率變高了。
D. 他們的抵押貸款一定被市場拒絕了。
normal.explain: 英文原句：They must have secured a favorable mortgage rate before the market shifted. (他們在市場變化前，一定已經爭取到優惠的房貸利率了。) secure 在此為獲得、爭取到之意。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
normal.speak: The entire residential neighborhood is gradually being gentrified by affluent developers.
options: A. 富有的開發商必須將整個住宅區拆除。
B. 整個住宅區一定是被當地居民自行翻新的。
C. 整個住宅區正逐漸被富裕的開發商進行都更與高級化。
D. 開發商正在考慮是否要投資這個住宅區。
normal.explain: 英文原句：The entire residential neighborhood is gradually being gentrified by affluent developers. (整個住宅區正逐漸被富裕的開發商進行都更與高級化。) gentrify 指老舊地區的士紳化、高級化。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
normal.speak: Our agents have been showing this exceptionally spacious apartment all afternoon.
options: A. 我們的房仲整個下午都在展示這間極度寬敞的公寓。
B. 我們的房仲必須在下午前把這間寬敞的公寓賣掉。
C. 這間寬敞的公寓下午才剛被我們的房仲租出去。
D. 客戶整個下午都在抱怨這間公寓不夠寬敞。
normal.explain: 英文原句：Our agents have been showing this exceptionally spacious apartment all afternoon. (我們的房仲整個下午都在展示這間極度寬敞的公寓。) spacious 指寬敞的。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
normal.speak: The property taxes are projected to be reassessed in the upcoming fiscal year.
options: A. 房地產稅被要求在下個財政年度前繳清。
B. 房產稅金一定在上一季就已經重新評估過了。
C. 下個財政年度的房產稅金預計將被取消。
D. 房地產稅預計將在即將到來的財政年度進行重新評估。
normal.explain: 英文原句：The property taxes are projected to be reassessed in the upcoming fiscal year. (房地產稅預計將在即將到來的財政年度進行重新評估。) are projected to be + V-p.p. 表示被預估將發生...

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
normal.speak: The previous occupants must have neglected the routine plumbing maintenance.
options: A. 之前的住戶必須賠償水管維修的費用。
B. 之前的住戶一定是疏忽了例行的管線維護。
C. 前住戶一直在抱怨管線維護做得很差。
D. 例行的管線維護必須交由前住戶負責。
normal.explain: 英文原句：The previous occupants must have neglected the routine plumbing maintenance. (之前的住戶一定是疏忽了例行的管線維護。) neglect 疏忽、忽略。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
normal.speak: We have been advising our clients to bid higher in this highly competitive market. What do you think?
options: A. The market has been falling recently, so we should sell now.
B. The clients must have forgotten their bid.

D. You must have advised them to withdraw their applications.
normal.explain: 對話情境：房仲表示在競爭激烈的市場中一直建議客戶提高出價，問對方意見。選項 C「我同意，有競爭力的報價預計將是成交的關鍵」最符合邏輯。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
normal.speak: The marketing director must have muted his microphone accidentally.
options: A. 行銷總監必須把他的麥克風靜音。
B. 行銷總監的麥克風一定壞掉了。
C. 行銷總監不小心把麥克風弄丟了。
D. 行銷總監一定是不小心把麥克風靜音了。
normal.explain: 英文原句：The marketing director must have muted his microphone accidentally. (行銷總監一定是不小心把麥克風靜音了。) mute 在此作動詞，表示靜音。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
normal.speak: We have been experiencing significant latency on this international video call.
options: A. 這通國際視訊通話的連線延遲問題一直很嚴重。
B. 視訊通話的參與者必須解決網路延遲問題。
C. 這通國際通話一定是提早結束了。
D. 我們一直在嘗試發起一通國際視訊通話。
normal.explain: 英文原句：We have been experiencing significant latency on this international video call. (這通國際視訊通話的連線延遲問題一直很嚴重。) latency 表示延遲。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
normal.speak: The quarterly financial projections are expected to be presented by the regional heads.
options: A. 各區負責人必須在下一季提出財務預測。
B. 季度的財務預測預計將由各區負責人來進行簡報。
C. 財務預測一定是由各區負責人親自審核的。
D. 各區負責人一直在拒絕提出季度財務報告。
normal.explain: 英文原句：The quarterly financial projections are expected to be presented by the regional heads. (季度的財務預測預計將由各區負責人來進行簡報。) projections 在此指預測數據。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
normal.speak: The software development team has been synchronizing their code repositories.
options: A. 軟體開發團隊必須加密他們的程式碼庫。
B. 軟體開發團隊一直在刪除舊的程式碼。
C. 軟體開發團隊一直在同步他們的程式碼庫。
D. 程式碼庫一定是被軟體開發團隊誤刪了。
normal.explain: 英文原句：The software development team has been synchronizing their code repositories. (軟體開發團隊一直在同步他們的程式碼庫。) synchronize 為同步。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
normal.speak: His sudden disconnection must have been caused by an insufficient bandwidth issue.
options: A. 頻寬不足的問題必須立刻被解決。
B. 他突然斷線一定是因為頻寬不足的問題造成的。
C. 他的頻寬一直在影響別人的通話品質。
D. 頻寬問題一定會導致更多人斷線。
normal.explain: 英文原句：His sudden disconnection must have been caused by an insufficient bandwidth issue. (他突然斷線一定是因為頻寬不足的問題造成的。) bandwidth 指頻寬。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
normal.speak: A consensus is unlikely to be reached without further internal deliberation.
options: A. 內部商議必須在達成共識前就先中斷。
B. 我們一直在內部商議是否要達成共識。
C. 若沒有進一步的內部商議，不太可能達成共識。
D. 共識一定是經過了長期的內部商議才達成的。
normal.explain: 英文原句：A consensus is unlikely to be reached without further internal deliberation. (若沒有進一步的內部商議，不太可能達成共識。) deliberation 指深思熟慮、商議。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
normal.speak: I have been struggling to hear the simultaneous translation due to the background static.
options: A. 背景雜音一定影響了所有的翻譯設備。
B. 我必須停止收聽同步口譯，因為雜訊太大了。
C. 同步口譯員一直在抱怨背景雜訊的問題。

normal.explain: 英文原句：I have been struggling to hear the simultaneous translation due to the background static. (因為背景雜訊，我一直很難聽清楚同步口譯。) static 在此作為名詞，指靜電干擾的雜音。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
normal.speak: The sensitive client data must have been encrypted prior to transmission.
options: A. 敏感的客戶資料在傳輸前一定已經被加密過了。
B. 我們必須在傳輸敏感的客戶資料前進行加密。

D. 客戶資料的傳輸一定是被加密軟體給阻擋了。
normal.explain: 英文原句：The sensitive client data must have been encrypted prior to transmission. (敏感的客戶資料在傳輸前一定已經被加密過了。) encrypt 指加密。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
normal.speak: Can you repeat the last point? I have been having trouble keeping up with the pace.
options: A. We have been running very fast on the track.

normal.explain: 對話情境：對方表示跟不上速度，請求重複最後一點。選項 D「沒問題，我會再過一次同步的步驟」合乎情境。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
normal.speak: The keynote presentation is being broadcast live to all our regional offices.

B. 各區域辦公室必須自行舉辦主題演講。
C. 主題演講一定已經在各辦公室播放完畢了。
D. 我們一直在所有的辦公室錄製主題演講。
normal.explain: 英文原句：The keynote presentation is being broadcast live to all our regional offices. (主題演講正在向我們所有的區域辦公室進行直播。) is being broadcast 為現在進行被動語態。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
normal.speak: The newly hired interns have been undergoing rigorous compliance training.
options: A. 新進實習生必須參加嚴格的法遵培訓。
B. 新進實習生一直在接受嚴格的合規與法遵培訓。

D. 實習生已經完成了所有的合規培訓課程。
normal.explain: 英文原句：The newly hired interns have been undergoing rigorous compliance training. (新進實習生一直在接受嚴格的合規與法遵培訓。) compliance 指合規性、遵守規定。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
normal.speak: This interactive module must have been designed to boost team cohesion.
options: A. 這個互動模組必須由團隊共同設計。
B. 團隊一直在利用這個模組來增強凝聚力。

D. 團隊凝聚力預計會因為這個模組而下降。
normal.explain: 英文原句：This interactive module must have been designed to boost team cohesion. (這個互動模組的設計初衷一定是要增強團隊凝聚力。) cohesion 凝聚力。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
normal.speak: The mandatory certification exam is structured to be completed within exactly two hours.
options: A. 強制性的認證考試一直都在兩個小時內結束。
B. 考試的結構一定是在兩小時內被設計出來的。
C. 考生必須在兩小時前抵達考場參加認證考試。
D. 這項強制性認證測驗的架構被設計為需在整整兩小時內完成。
normal.explain: 英文原句：The mandatory certification exam is structured to be completed within exactly two hours. (這項強制性認證測驗的架構被設計為需在整整兩小時內完成。) is structured to be 複雜被動，意指其架構被如此安排。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
normal.speak: We have been brainstorming ways to streamline our overly complex onboarding process.
options: A. 我們一直在腦力激盪，試圖簡化過度複雜的新人報到流程。

C. 新人報到流程必須被簡化才能節省成本。
D. 我們已經把過於複雜的入職流程全部刪除了。
normal.explain: 英文原句：We have been brainstorming ways to streamline our overly complex onboarding process. (我們一直在腦力激盪，試圖簡化過度複雜的新人報到流程。) streamline 有精簡、使有效率之意。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
normal.speak: The senior mentor must have imparted some invaluable industry insights to the trainees.
options: A. 資深導師必須向受訓者傳授產業見解。
B. 資深導師一定是傳授了極具價值的產業見解給受訓者。
C. 受訓者一直在向資深導師請教產業見解。
D. 極具價值的產業見解預計將由資深導師來發表。
normal.explain: 英文原句：The senior mentor must have imparted some invaluable industry insights to the trainees. (資深導師一定是傳授了極具價值的產業見解給受訓者。) impart 傳授、賦予。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
normal.speak: Attendance at the anti-harassment seminar is strictly mandated by corporate policy.
options: A. 反騷擾研討會的出席名單一定已經被公司寄出了。
B. 公司總部一直在追蹤反騷擾研討會的出席率。
C. 公司政策嚴格規定必須出席這場反騷擾研討會。
D. 必須由公司總部來主辦這場反騷擾研討會。
normal.explain: 英文原句：Attendance at the anti-harassment seminar is strictly mandated by corporate policy. (公司政策嚴格規定必須出席這場反騷擾研討會。) is mandated by 意為被...強制規定。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
normal.speak: The trainers have been circulating a detailed questionnaire to gauge your technical proficiency.
options: A. 訓練員一直在發放一份詳細的問卷來評估你們的技術熟練度。
B. 你們的技術熟練度一定已經被訓練員評估過了。
C. 訓練員必須透過問卷才能知道你們的技術熟練度。
D. 評估技術熟練度的問卷預計會在稍後發放。
normal.explain: 英文原句：The trainers have been circulating a detailed questionnaire to gauge your technical proficiency. (訓練員一直在發放一份詳細的問卷來評估你們的技術熟練度。) gauge 評估；proficiency 熟練度。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
normal.speak: The instructional materials are currently being translated into multiple regional languages, right?
options: A. Yes, they must have been lost during the translation process.
B. Exactly, they are expected to be ready for the global teams by next week.
C. We have been learning multiple languages since last year.
D. No, the translators have been fired due to poor proficiency.
normal.explain: 對話情境：對方確認教學材料是否正在被翻譯成多種語言。選項 B「沒錯，預計下週就能為全球團隊準備好」是合理的後續說明。

normal.desc: 【時態】The financial advisors ___ the recent market trends to identify new investment opportunities for their clients.
options: A. analyze
B. have been analyzing
C. are analyzed
D. will have analyzed
normal.explain: 題目強調一段時間內持續進行的動作，且與現在有關。使用現在完成進行式 (have been V-ing) 最符合語境。

normal.desc: 【推測語氣】The stock price crashed unexpectedly this morning. The CEO ___ some terrible news to the major shareholders.
options: A. must leak
B. should leak
C. must have leaked
D. could be leaking
normal.explain: 對於過去發生的事情作非常有把握的推測，使用 must have + 過去分詞 (must have leaked)。

normal.desc: 【被動語態】The sudden drop in cryptocurrency values is widely believed ___ by the new regulatory policies announced yesterday.
options: A. to have been triggered
B. triggering
C. to trigger
D. having triggered
normal.explain: 「被廣泛認為已經由...引發」，is believed 後接不定詞，因為動作發生在過去，用完成式被動不定詞 (to have been triggered)。

normal.desc: 【字彙】Investors are advised to diversify their ___ to reduce the risks associated with volatile markets.
options: A. dividends
B. allegations
C. portfolios
D. correlations
normal.explain: portfolio 意指「投資組合」。投資人應將投資組合多樣化以降低風險。dividend 為股息，allegation 為指控，correlation 為關聯性。

normal.desc:
【對話】A: Have you noticed the recent changes in our quarterly earnings?
B: Yes, the profits ___ drastically since the central bank adjusted the interest rates.
options: A. fluctuate
B. have been fluctuating
C. will fluctuate
D. had fluctuated
normal.explain: 從 since 子句可得知，利潤「一直持續」波動到現在，故使用現在完成進行式 (have been fluctuating)。

normal.desc: 【字彙】The company decided to ___ its assets in the overseas branch in order to pay off the accumulating debt.
options: A. liquidate
B. mitigate
C. dismantle
D. deplete
normal.explain: liquidate 意為「變賣（資產）、清算」。為了還債而變賣資產符合邏輯。mitigate 為減輕，dismantle 為拆除，deplete 為耗盡。

normal.desc: 【短文】Investment Column: Tech giants have been pouring billions into quantum computing research. The market for this advanced technology is projected to be dominated by a few key players. Given the rapid patent acquisitions, these companies must have foreseen the immense profitability of this sector long before their competitors. Q: What is implied about the tech giants?
options: A. They are currently losing money in research.
B. They anticipated the financial benefits early on.
C. They have been struggling to acquire new patents.
D. They failed to dominate the new tech market.
normal.explain: 文中提到「must have foreseen the immense profitability... long before their competitors」，暗示他們早就預見了這項技術的經濟效益 (anticipated the financial benefits early on)。

normal.desc: 【短文】Financial Advisory: The board of directors has been debating the distribution of annual profits. A substantial ___ is expected to be paid out to shareholders next month, rewarding their loyalty during the volatile fiscal year. Q: Which word fits the blank best?
options: A. dividend
B. backlash
C. mandate
D. scrutiny
normal.explain: 發放給股東 (shareholders) 的是股息 (dividend)。backlash 是強烈反彈，mandate 是命令，scrutiny 是審查。

normal.desc: 【時態】Environmental inspectors ___ the water quality of the river since the chemical spill occurred.
options: A. monitored
B. have been monitoring
C. will monitor
D. are monitored
normal.explain: 自化學外洩發生以來，調查員「一直在監測」水質，故用現在完成進行式。

normal.desc: 【被動語態】The endangered species is reported ___ a remarkable recovery due to the new conservation laws.
options: A. making
B. to make
C. to have made
D. made
normal.explain: 據報導，該物種已經復育成功。「已經發生」的動作接在 is reported to 之後，用完成式不定詞 (to have made)。

normal.desc: 【推測語氣】The air pollution levels dropped significantly overnight. The factories ___ their operations during the inspection.
options: A. must halt
B. must have halted
C. should halt
D. will have halted
normal.explain: 針對過去狀況的肯定推測：「工廠一定是在檢查期間暫停了運作」，用 must have + V-en。

normal.desc: 【字彙】The government issued a strict ___ requiring all automotive manufacturers to reduce their carbon emissions by 30%.
options: A. stimulus
B. correlation
C. mandate
D. dividend
normal.explain: mandate 意指「官方命令、規定」。政府發布命令要求車廠減碳。stimulus 為刺激物，correlation 為關聯。

normal.desc:
【對話】A: Why is the construction of the new dam delayed?
B: The contractors ___ the ecological impact for months, and they finally concluded it would be too destructive.
options: A. evaluate
B. have been evaluating
C. are evaluating
D. evaluated
normal.explain: 承包商「好幾個月來一直在評估」生態影響，強調動作的持續與累積，用現在完成進行式。

normal.desc: 【字彙】If we continue to ___ our natural resources at this alarming rate, future generations will face severe shortages.
options: A. mitigate
B. deplete
C. liquidate
D. accumulate
normal.explain: deplete 意為「耗盡、大量減少」。消耗自然資源符合文意。mitigate 是減輕，accumulate 是累積。

normal.desc: 【短文】Green Energy Report: The coastal wind farm project has been facing strong opposition from local fisheries. The turbines are proven to have disrupted the migratory patterns of certain fish species. The planning committee must have ignored the preliminary marine biology reports when selecting the site. Q: Why did the project face opposition?
options: A. The turbines are too expensive to maintain.
B. It negatively affects local fish migration.
C. The local fisheries want to build their own wind farm.
D. The committee refused to hire marine biologists.
normal.explain: 文中指出風力發電機破壞了魚類的洄游路徑 (disrupted the migratory patterns)，導致當地漁業反對。

normal.desc: 【短文】Environmental News: To ___ the devastating effects of deforestation, the local council has launched a massive tree-planting campaign. This initiative is highly expected to restore the regional climate balance over the next decade. Q: Which word fits the blank best?
options: A. mitigate
B. dismantle
C. speculate
D. fluctuate
normal.explain: mitigate 意為「減輕、緩和」。為了減輕森林砍伐帶來的破壞性影響，發起了植樹活動。dismantle 為拆除，speculate 為投機/猜測。

normal.desc: 【時態】The engineering team ___ the faulty braking mechanism since the first customer reported the issue.
options: A. investigated
B. investigates
C. has been investigating
D. is investigated
normal.explain: 自第一位顧客回報問題以來，團隊「一直在調查」，使用現在完成進行式。

normal.desc: 【推測語氣】The infant car seats detached during the crash test. The factory ___ a defective batch of locking clips.
options: A. must have used
B. uses
C. must use
D. should use
normal.explain: 推測過去發生的事：「工廠一定使用了有瑕疵的零件」，用 must have used。

normal.desc: 【被動語態】The contaminated food products are required ___ from all supermarket shelves immediately to prevent further illness.
options: A. to remove
B. to be removed
C. removed
D. removing
normal.explain: 產品「被要求從架上移除」，因此 require 後方接被動的不定詞 to be removed。

normal.desc: 【字彙】Prolonged exposure to these chemical fumes is highly ___ to human health and can cause respiratory failure.
options: A. vulnerable
B. hazardous
C. volatile
D. substandard
normal.explain: hazardous 意為「危險的、有害的」。對人體健康有害符合語境。vulnerable 為脆弱的，volatile 為易揮發/波動的。

normal.desc:
【對話】A: Is it true that the new smartphones are catching fire?
B: Yes, the battery units are known ___ to overheating under extreme pressure.
options: A. to have been susceptible
B. to suspect
C. to have suspected
D. suspecting
normal.explain: 電池被認為「過去一直易受過熱影響」，用完成式被動不定詞 (to have been susceptible)。susceptible 為易受影響的。

normal.desc: 【字彙】Because of the severe safety risk, the manufacturer decided to completely ___ the production line and rebuild it.
options: A. accumulate
B. liquidate
C. dismantle
D. mitigate
normal.explain: dismantle 意為「拆除、解散」。因安全風險而拆除生產線重建符合邏輯。

normal.desc: 【短文】Recall Notice: We have been receiving reports of a critical software glitch in the Model X pacemakers. The device is confirmed to have occasionally skipped beats during high-intensity exercise. Patients must have experienced sudden dizziness as a result. A free firmware update will be provided at all clinics. Q: What symptom did the glitch likely cause for patients?
options: A. Software crashes
B. Sudden dizziness
C. High blood pressure
D. Excessive sweating
normal.explain: 文中提到「Patients must have experienced sudden dizziness...」，因此最可能造成的症狀是突發性頭暈 (dizziness)。

normal.desc: 【短文】Safety Warning: The electrical wiring in the recent batch of space heaters is considered to be ___. Several units have already melted during use. The quality assurance team must have bypassed the final thermal stress test. Q: Which word fits the blank best?
options: A. cognitive
B. substandard
C. susceptible
D. intrinsic
normal.explain: substandard 意指「不合標準的、劣質的」。電線品質劣質導致融化。cognitive 為認知的，intrinsic 為內在的。

normal.desc: 【時態】Psychologists ___ the impact of social media on adolescent self-esteem for several years now.
options: A. examine
B. have been examining
C. are examined
D. will examine
normal.explain: 「這幾年來一直在研究」，持續到現在的動作，用現在完成進行式。

normal.desc: 【被動語態】The unusual behavioral pattern is hypothesized ___ by severe childhood trauma.
options: A. causing
B. to have been caused
C. to cause
D. having caused
normal.explain: 這種行為模式被假設「是過去由童年創傷所引起的」，使用完成式被動不定詞 (to have been caused)。

normal.desc: 【推測語氣】The participants reacted identically to the placebo. The researchers ___ the instructions clearly enough.
options: A. must have explained
B. shouldn't explain
C. must not have explained
D. wouldn't explain
normal.explain: 對過去事實的否定推測：「研究人員一定沒有把指示解釋清楚」，用 must not have + V-en。

normal.desc: 【字彙】The study found a strong ___ between chronic stress and a decline in memory retention among the elderly.
options: A. mandate
B. correlation
C. allegation
D. dividend
normal.explain: correlation 意為「關聯、相關性」。研究發現慢性壓力與記憶力衰退有強烈關聯。

normal.desc:
【對話】A: What did the latest neurological study reveal?
B: It suggested that our perception of time ___ drastically when we are exposed to high-adrenaline situations.
options: A. deviates
B. mitigates
C. dismantles
D. liquidates
normal.explain: deviate 意為「偏離」。人在高腎上腺素情況下，對時間的感知會大幅偏離常態。

normal.desc: 【字彙】Children are highly ___ to external influences, which is why positive reinforcement is crucial during early development.
options: A. volatile
B. susceptible
C. substandard
D. hazardous
normal.explain: susceptible to 意為「易受...影響的」。孩童容易受外在影響，故選此字。

normal.desc: 【短文】Psychology Journal: The subjects have been performing poorly on the memory tasks since the background noise was introduced. The auditory ___ is proven to have disrupted their concentration. The scientists must have underestimated the brain's sensitivity to random sounds. Q: Which word fits the blank best?
options: A. stimulus
B. dividend
C. mandate
D. backlash
normal.explain: stimulus 意為「刺激物」。聽覺刺激 (auditory stimulus) 擾亂了他們的注意力。其他選項皆不合語意。

normal.desc: 【短文】Research Summary: We have been observing the participants' reactions to visual illusions. The visual cortex is understood to have processed the conflicting images at different speeds. The delay in processing must have manifested as a feeling of confusion in the subjects. Q: What was the physical result of the processing delay?
options: A. A feeling of confusion
B. Enhanced visual memory
C. Faster reaction times
D. Damage to the visual cortex
normal.explain: 文中指出「The delay in processing must have manifested as a feeling of confusion」，故結果為困惑感。

normal.desc: 【時態】The public relations team ___ tirelessly to salvage the brand's reputation since the scandal broke out.
options: A. works
B. has been working
C. will work
D. is working
normal.explain: 自醜聞爆發以來，公關團隊「一直持續在努力」挽救聲譽，用現在完成進行式。

normal.desc: 【推測語氣】The confidential emails were leaked to the press. A high-ranking executive ___ the company's internal server.
options: A. must sabotage
B. must have sabotaged
C. shouldn't sabotage
D. will have sabotaged
normal.explain: 對過去事件的肯定推測：「某個高層主管一定暗中破壞/駭入了內部伺服器」，用 must have V-en。

normal.desc: 【被動語態】The former CEO is widely known ___ company funds for personal luxury expenses over the last five years.
options: A. to embezzle
B. to have embezzled
C. embezzling
D. embezzled
normal.explain: 前執行長被廣泛認為「過去曾經盜用公款」。發生在過去的動作接在 is known 之後，用完成式不定詞 (to have embezzled)。

normal.desc:
【對話】A: How is the company handling the sudden drop in sales and public trust?
B: They are facing intense ___ from the media, and a formal apology is expected to be issued soon.
options: A. dividend
B. scrutiny
C. correlation
D. stimulus
normal.explain: scrutiny 意指「密切審查、嚴格關注」。公司面臨媒體的嚴厲檢視。dividend 為股息，correlation 為關聯。

normal.desc: 【字彙】To restore consumer confidence, the corporation must accept full ___ for the environmental disaster they caused.
options: A. accountability
B. backlash
C. allegation
D. vulnerability
normal.explain: accountability 意為「當責、責任」。企業必須承擔全部責任。backlash 是反彈，allegation 是指控。

normal.desc: 【字彙】The severe public ___ forced the board of directors to reconsider their controversial restructuring plan.
options: A. dividend
B. backlash
C. compliance
D. portfolio
normal.explain: backlash 意為「強烈反彈、反對」。公眾的強烈反彈迫使董事會重新考慮計畫。compliance 為遵守。

boss.desc: 【綜合】Business Review: The retail giant's downfall is generally understood to have been triggered by its failure to adapt to e-commerce. For years, executives had been ignoring the digital shift, mistakenly believing their brick-and-mortar dominance was unassailable. They must have severely miscalculated consumer behavior. Now, large-scale layoffs are expected to be announced. Q: Which of the following best describes the executives' past mindset?
options: A. They were overly confident in their physical stores.
B. They were pioneering the transition to digital sales.
C. They have been constantly restructuring the company.
D. They expected the layoffs to boost their stock price.
boss.explain: 文中指出主管們誤以為他們的實體店優勢是無懈可擊的 (mistakenly believing their brick-and-mortar dominance was unassailable)，代表他們對實體店過度自信。

boss.desc: 【綜合】Science Journal: Anthropologists have been debating the purpose of the newly discovered ruins. The complex structure is hypothesized to have been utilized as a celestial observatory. Given the precision of the stonework, the builders must have possessed advanced mathematical knowledge. Q: What is the main conclusion drawn about the ancient builders?
options: A. They struggled with complex architectural designs.
B. They were highly skilled in mathematics.
C. They used the ruins primarily for religious rituals.
D. They have been living in the region for centuries.
boss.explain: 短文推論「the builders must have possessed advanced mathematical knowledge」（建造者一定具備先進的數學知識），故選 B。

boss.desc: 【綜合】Policy Paper Summary: The proposed carbon tax has been facing fierce opposition from industrial sectors. Proponents argue that the measure is essential and is proven to have reduced emissions in neighboring countries. The government's failure to consult industry leaders beforehand must have exacerbated the backlash. Q: Why did the policy face a severe backlash according to the passage?
options: A. It failed to reduce emissions in neighboring countries.
B. The government did not communicate with industry leaders in advance.
C. Industrial sectors have been demanding higher taxes.
D. Proponents did not believe the measure was essential.
boss.explain: 文中提到「The government's failure to consult industry leaders beforehand must have exacerbated the backlash」（政府事前未諮詢業界領袖一定加劇了反彈）。

boss.desc: 【綜合】Tech News: Developers have been working around the clock to patch a critical vulnerability. The security flaw is reported to have compromised the data of millions of users. The company's stock plummeted following the breach; investors must have panicked over the potential legal liabilities. Q: What was the consequence of the security flaw?
options: A. The developers were sued by the investors.
B. Millions of users lost their internet connection.
C. The company's stock value dropped sharply.
D. The vulnerability was patched before any data was lost.
boss.explain: 文章明確指出「The company's stock plummeted following the breach」（漏洞發生後公司股票暴跌）。

boss.desc: 【綜合】Editorial Opinion: The housing crisis is often said to have been caused solely by foreign investors. However, domestic policies have been restricting urban development for decades. The city council must have ignored the growing population metrics when zoning the residential areas. Q: What does the author believe is a major factor in the housing crisis?
options: A. An influx of foreign workers.
B. Restrictive domestic urban development policies.
C. Overdevelopment of residential areas.
D. Accurate tracking of population metrics.
boss.explain: 作者認為雖然常被說是外國投資者造成的，但國內政策數十年來一直在限制都市發展 (domestic policies have been restricting...)，這才是真正的關鍵因素。

boss.desc: 【語法結構】Not only ___ a profound impact on the local economy, but the new infrastructure is also expected to attract foreign investment.
options: A. the project has had
B. has the project had
C. the project is having
D. is the project had
boss.explain: 否定副詞 Not only 放句首時，後方需接倒裝句型（助動詞移至主詞前），故選 has the project had。

boss.desc: 【綜合】Medical Breakthrough: A new synthetic compound is purported to have cured several autoimmune diseases in clinical trials. Researchers have been refining its chemical structure to minimize side effects. The initial funding agency must have recognized its immense potential early on, given their continuous financial support. Q: What are researchers currently trying to achieve?
options: A. Secure more funding from the agency.
B. Reduce the side effects of the synthetic compound.
C. Prove that autoimmune diseases are incurable.
D. Patent the chemical structure globally.
boss.explain: 文中指出「Researchers have been refining its chemical structure to minimize side effects」（研究人員一直在改良其化學結構以將副作用降至最低）。

boss.desc: 【綜合】Corporate Memo: The merger with Apex Corp is anticipated to be finalized by the fourth quarter. Both legal teams have been scrutinizing the contractual obligations diligently. Any discrepancies found now must have been overlooked during the initial audit phase. Q: What is implied about the initial audit phase?
options: A. It was conducted flawlessly without errors.
B. It was handled exclusively by Apex Corp.
C. It might not have been thorough enough.
D. It was deliberately delayed by the legal teams.
boss.explain: 文中提到「現在發現的任何差異一定是在初步審計階段被忽略的」，暗示初步審計可能不夠徹底。

boss.desc: 【綜合】Travel Advisory: Travelers have been experiencing unprecedented delays at the international terminal due to a staff strike. The situation is estimated to be resolved within 48 hours. Passengers whose flights were cancelled must have been notified via email or text message. Q: What caused the delays at the international terminal?
options: A. Severe weather conditions.
B. A malfunction in the booking system.
C. A work stoppage by employees.
D. Unprecedented passenger volume.
boss.explain: 短文指出延誤是由於「staff strike」（員工罷工），即選項中的 work stoppage by employees。

boss.desc: 【語法結構】Scarcely ___ the press conference when a reporter asked a provocative question about the scandal.
options: A. had the CEO begun
B. the CEO had begun
C. has the CEO begun
D. the CEO began
boss.explain: 否定副詞 Scarcely 放句首時需倒裝，且配合 when 引導的過去式子句，主要子句應用過去完成式，故選 had the CEO begun。

boss.desc: 【綜合】Environmental Report: The shrinking of the ice caps is widely acknowledged to have accelerated over the last decade. Scientists have been urging policymakers to implement stringent regulations. The continuous dismissal of these warnings must have contributed significantly to the current ecological crisis. Q: What is the main point regarding policymakers?
options: A. They have successfully implemented stringent regulations.
B. Their disregard of scientific warnings worsened the crisis.
C. They are widely acknowledged to have accelerated the research.
D. They have been urging scientists to collect more data.
boss.explain: 文中提到「The continuous dismissal of these warnings must have contributed significantly...」（不斷忽視這些警告肯定大大促成了當前的危機），指出決策者的忽視使情況惡化。

boss.desc: 【綜合】Art History Analysis: The stolen masterpiece is now believed to have been smuggled out of the country in a freight container. Detectives have been tracking a notorious art syndicate connected to the heist. Security guards at the museum must have been bribed, as the alarm system was manually disabled. Q: How did the thieves likely manage to disable the alarm system?
options: A. By hacking into the main server.
B. By paying off the museum's security personnel.
C. By smuggling a device in a freight container.
D. By cutting the power supply to the building.
boss.explain: 文中明確推測「Security guards at the museum must have been bribed」（保全一定被收買了），對應選項 B (paying off security personnel)。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
boss.speak: The true operational costs have been deliberately obscured by the accounting firm.
options: A. 會計師事務所大幅降低了實際的營運成本。
B. 真實的營運成本已經被清晰且透明地公開。
C. 真實的營運成本已被會計師事務所蓄意掩蓋。
D. 會計師事務所發現了營運成本中的重大錯誤。
boss.explain: The true operational costs have been deliberately obscured by the accounting firm. (真實的營運成本已被會計師事務所蓄意掩蓋。) obscure 作動詞指「掩蓋、使模糊」；deliberately 意為「蓄意地」。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
boss.speak: The domestic economy must have been more resilient to inflation than the experts predicted.
options: A. 國內經濟對通貨膨脹的反應非常脆弱且敏感。
B. 經濟專家極度準確地預測了經濟的反彈趨勢。
C. 國內經濟完全沒有受到任何通貨膨脹的影響。
D. 國內經濟對通膨的抵抗力一定比專家預測的更強。
boss.explain: The domestic economy must have been more resilient to inflation than the experts predicted. (國內經濟對通膨的抵抗力一定比專家預測的更強。) resilient 指「有韌性的、能迅速恢復的」；must have been 表強烈推測。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
boss.speak: The consistently high interest rates have been deterring potential foreign investors.
options: A. 持續的高利率一直阻礙著潛在的外國投資者。
B. 持續的高利率成功吸引了大量的外國資金。
C. 潛在的投資者對目前的高利率狀態毫不在乎。
D. 外國投資者持續要求銀行提供更高的利率。
boss.explain: The consistently high interest rates have been deterring potential foreign investors. (持續的高利率一直阻礙著潛在的外國投資者。) deter 指「阻嚇、使打消念頭」；使用現在完成進行式強調此現象持續發生。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
boss.speak: An intricate network of environmental sensors is being installed across the metropolitan area.
options: A. 城市目前正在拆除原本極為複雜的感測器網路。
B. 一個複雜的環境感測器網路正在大都會區安裝中。
C. 一個簡易且基礎的感測器網路已經安裝完畢。
D. 大都會區嚴重缺乏用於監控環境的感測器硬體。
boss.explain: An intricate network of environmental sensors is being installed across the metropolitan area. (一個複雜的環境感測器網路正在大都會區安裝中。) intricate 指「錯綜複雜的」；is being installed 為現在進行被動語態。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
boss.speak: Several key financial details must have been omitted from the final quarterly report.
options: A. 最終的季度報告完整包含了所有的財務細節。
B. 季度報告中的一些細節被刻意過度強調了。
C. 最終的季報中一定遺漏了幾個關鍵的財務細節。
D. 公司的最終財務報告尚未編寫完成。
boss.explain: Several key financial details must have been omitted from the final quarterly report. (最終的季報中一定遺漏了幾個關鍵的財務細節。) omit 指「遺漏、省略」；must have been omitted 結合了情態動詞與被動語態。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
boss.speak: She has been taking a significantly more prominent role in the international trade negotiations.
options: A. I heard she recently resigned from her corporate role.
B. International trade volumes are unfortunately declining.
C. The negotiations have been stalled for weeks anyway.
D. Her leadership has really helped push things forward.
boss.explain: She has been taking a significantly more prominent role in the international trade negotiations. (她在國際貿易談判中一直扮演著更為突出的角色。) prominent 指「突出的、顯著的」；回應讚賞她的領導能力推動了進展最合適。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
boss.speak: A rapid shift towards renewable energy sources is being strongly advocated by policy makers.
options: A. 政策制定者正強烈主張迅速轉向再生能源。
B. 政策制定者極力反對在近期內使用再生能源。
C. 轉向再生能源的全球性政策轉型已經徹底完成。
D. 目前沒有任何政府官員支持再生能源的發展計畫。
boss.explain: A rapid shift towards renewable energy sources is being strongly advocated by policy makers. (政策制定者正強烈主張迅速轉向再生能源。) advocate 作動詞指「提倡、主張」；is being strongly advocated 為被動語態。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
boss.speak: The emergency rescue efforts must have been severely hampered by the unexpected snowstorm.
options: A. Luckily, the snowstorm cleared up very quickly.
B. Yes, it made reaching the remote site almost impossible.
C. The rescue operation was declared a complete success.
D. We unfortunately don't have enough rescue teams right now.
boss.explain: The emergency rescue efforts must have been severely hampered by the unexpected snowstorm. (緊急救援行動一定受到了意外暴風雪的嚴重阻礙。) hamper 指「妨礙、阻礙」；回答「是的，這讓抵達偏遠現場幾乎成為不可能」符合因果關係。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
boss.speak: We have been comprehensively analyzing the long-term implications of this major policy shift.
options: A. 我們刻意忽略了這項重大政策轉變可能帶來的長期影響。
B. 專家認為這項重大政策轉變並不會帶來任何實際影響。
C. 我們一直在全面分析這項重大政策轉變的長期影響。
D. 公司高層認為短期的營利影響遠比長期的政策影響重要。
boss.explain: We have been comprehensively analyzing the long-term implications of this major policy shift. (我們一直在全面分析這項重大政策轉變的長期影響。) implication 在此指「可能引發的後果、影響」；comprehensively 意為「全面地」。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
boss.speak: A significant portion of the generated revenue is expected to be reinvested into research and development.
options: A. We are actually losing a lot of money this fiscal year.
B. R&D has been entirely defunded by the new management.
C. The revenue was strictly set aside for paying off old debt.
D. That should really help us innovate faster for next year.
boss.explain: A significant portion of the generated revenue is expected to be reinvested into research and development. (產生的一大部分營收預計將重新投資於研發。) revenue 指「營收」；投資研發的回應「那應該能幫助我們明年加速創新」最恰當。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
boss.speak: The engineering team must have worked for three consecutive weekends to meet that impossible deadline.
options: A. 工程團隊一定連續工作了三個週末才趕上那個不可能的期限。
B. 即使工程團隊努力了，他們依然錯過了那個最後期限。
C. 為了保持效率，工程團隊在過去的幾個週末都在休息。
D. 工程團隊只花了一個週末的時間就完成了那項困難的工作。
boss.explain: The engineering team must have worked for three consecutive weekends to meet that impossible deadline. (工程團隊一定連續工作了三個週末才趕上那個不可能的期限。) consecutive 指「連續的」；must have worked 推測過去已發生的努力。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
boss.speak: The current foreign exchange market situation is considered to be highly volatile at this particular moment.
options: A. The market is completely stable right now, don't worry.
B. Perhaps we should delay our large currency conversion then.
C. Exchange rates basically never change in this region.
D. Volatility is just a myth invented by stock brokers.
boss.explain: The current foreign exchange market situation is considered to be highly volatile at this particular moment. (目前的匯市情況在此刻被認為是高度波動的。) volatile 指「易變的、波動大的」；回應「或許我們該延後大額外幣兌換」是明智的對策。
