boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
boss.speak: Substantial discrepancies in the financial statements must have been overlooked during the initial audit.
options: A. 財務報表中的重大差異一定是在初步審計時被忽略了。
B. 我們必須在初步審計時找出財務報表中的重大差異。
C. 初步審計時，財務報表中的重大差異並沒有被忽略。
D. 財務報表中的重大差異導致了初步審計的失敗。
boss.explain: 原句：Substantial discrepancies in the financial statements must have been overlooked during the initial audit. 意思：財務報表中的重大差異一定是在初步審計時被忽略了。discrepancy (差異)、overlook (忽略)。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
boss.speak: The proposed merger has been facing mounting opposition from key shareholders.
options: A. Key shareholders must have proposed a new merger.
B. Are they planning to restructure the deal to appease them?
C. The opposition was mounted on the wall.
D. Mergers are always very agreeable to everyone.
boss.explain: 原句：The proposed merger has been facing mounting opposition from key shareholders.（提議的合併案一直面臨來自主要股東日益增加的反對。）回應 B「他們打算重組交易來安撫他們嗎？」展現對商業困境的理解。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
boss.speak: The outdated machinery is slated to be dismantled and replaced by automated robotics.
options: A. 過時的機械預計將被拆除，並由自動化機器人取代。
B. 自動化機器人正在拆除過時的機械。
C. 我們不打算拆除過時的機械，而是直接引入機器人。
D. 過時的機械已經被自動化機器人完全取代了。
boss.explain: 原句：The outdated machinery is slated to be dismantled and replaced by automated robotics. 意思：過時的機械預計將被拆除，並由自動化機器人取代。is slated to be 預計將被...

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
boss.speak: The sudden dip in our quarterly earnings must have been triggered by the global supply chain disruptions.
options: A. 季度收益的突然下滑一定是全球供應鏈中斷所引發的。
B. 全球供應鏈中斷必須由季度收益的下滑來觸發。
C. 季度收益的下滑並沒有受到全球供應鏈中斷的影響。
D. 為了防止供應鏈中斷，我們必須接受季度收益下滑。
boss.explain: 原句：The sudden dip in our quarterly earnings must have been triggered by the global supply chain disruptions. 意思：季度收益的突然下滑一定是全球供應鏈中斷所引發的。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
boss.speak: The research and development department has been spearheading the initiative to utilize biodegradable materials.
options: A. Have they encountered any structural integrity issues with those materials?
B. The department must have thrown a spear at the materials.
C. Biodegradable materials are not biodegradable at all.
D. They will initiate the department soon.
boss.explain: 原句：The R&D department has been spearheading the initiative to utilize biodegradable materials.（研發部門一直主導使用可生物降解材料的倡議。）回應 A「他們使用這些材料有遇到任何結構完整性的問題嗎？」邏輯最通順。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
boss.speak: The strict environmental regulations are expected to be enforced rigorously by the newly appointed committee.
options: A. 嚴格的環境法規已經被新成立的委員會廢除了。
B. 預計新成立的委員會將嚴格執行這些環境法規。
C. 新成立的委員會預計將放寬嚴格的環境法規。
D. 新成立的委員會無法嚴格執行環境法規。
boss.explain: 原句：The strict environmental regulations are expected to be enforced rigorously by the newly appointed committee. 意思：預計新成立的委員會將嚴格執行這些環境法規。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
boss.speak: The subtle nuances in his speech must have been misinterpreted by the international press.
options: A. 國際媒體一定誤解了他演講中微妙的言外之意。
B. 他必須在演講中向國際媒體解釋微妙的言外之意。
C. 國際媒體完美地詮釋了他演講中微妙的言外之意。
D. 他的演講沒有任何微妙的言外之意讓國際媒體誤解。
boss.explain: 原句：The subtle nuances in his speech must have been misinterpreted by the international press. 意思：國際媒體一定誤解了他演講中微妙的言外之意。nuance 指細微差別、言外之意。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
boss.speak: We have been revamping the entire user interface to enhance the overall customer experience.
options: A. The customer experience must have been revamped.
B. When is the rollout date for the new design?
C. We should user interface the entire customer.
D. The overall experience is very entire.
boss.explain: 原句：We have been revamping the entire user interface to enhance the overall customer experience.（我們一直在改版整個使用者介面以提升整體客戶體驗。）回應 B「新設計的推出日期是什麼時候？」最合理。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
boss.speak: The controversial policy is presumed to be abandoned following the massive public outcry.
options: A. 在大規模的公眾強烈抗議之後，這項具爭議的政策預計將被放棄。
B. 這項具爭議的政策引發了公眾強烈抗議，但政府堅持執行。
C. 儘管有大規模的公眾抗議，這項政策仍然預計會被實施。
D. 這項具爭議的政策是為了平息公眾的強烈抗議而制定的。
boss.explain: 原句：The controversial policy is presumed to be abandoned following the massive public outcry. 意思：在大規模的公眾強烈抗議之後，這項具爭議的政策預計將被放棄。is presumed to be (推測將被)。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
boss.speak: The sudden resignation of the chief financial officer must have exacerbated the investors' panic.
options: A. 財務長的突然辭職一定加劇了投資者的恐慌。
B. 財務長必須辭職以平息投資者的恐慌。
C. 財務長的突然辭職減輕了投資者的恐慌。
D. 投資者的恐慌一定導致了財務長的突然辭職。
boss.explain: 原句：The sudden resignation of the chief financial officer must have exacerbated the investors' panic. 意思：財務長的突然辭職一定加劇了投資者的恐慌。exacerbate 加劇、惡化。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
boss.speak: The city council has been subsidizing public transportation to alleviate traffic congestion.
options: A. The traffic congestion must have subsidized the city.
B. Has there been a noticeable decrease in rush-hour traffic?
C. We should alleviate the public transportation.
D. City councils are usually located in the city center.
boss.explain: 原句：The city council has been subsidizing public transportation to alleviate traffic congestion.（市議會一直在補貼大眾運輸以緩解交通擁塞。）回應 B「尖峰時段的交通量有明顯減少嗎？」最符合邏輯。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
boss.speak: The initial patent application is deemed to be invalid due to prior art references.
options: A. 最初的專利申請因先前的技術參考文獻被視為無效。
B. 最初的專利申請被視為有效，並將成為技術參考。
C. 我們必須使最初的專利申請失效以引用先前的技術。
D. 先前的技術參考文獻因最初的專利申請而無效。
boss.explain: 原句：The initial patent application is deemed to be invalid due to prior art references. 意思：最初的專利申請因先前的技術參考文獻被視為無效。is deemed to be (被視為)。

boss.desc: 【短文】Legal Brief: Section 4 of the employment contract has been undergoing major revisions. The termination clause is considered to have been too ambiguous in the previous version. The drafting committee must have realized that a clearer definition of gross misconduct was necessary to protect the company from wrongful dismissal lawsuits. Q: Why was Section 4 revised?
options: A. To provide more vacation days for employees.
B. Because the previous termination rules lacked clarity.
C. To prevent the drafting committee from resigning.
D. Because lawsuits have bankrupted the company.
boss.explain: 文中提到 termination clause is considered to have been too ambiguous (解雇條款被認為太過模稜兩可)，且需要 clearer definition (更清晰的定義)，故選 B。

boss.desc: 【短文】Notice of Liability: The contractor has been ignoring our repeated warnings regarding the use of substandard materials. Consequently, the structural damage is determined to be solely their responsibility. They must have intentionally bypassed the rigorous quality checks to cut costs. Legal proceedings will commence shortly. Q: What is the contractor accused of doing?
options: A. Delaying the project timeline on purpose.
B. Skipping required quality inspections to save money.
C. Suing the company for unreasonable demands.
D. Overcharging for the standard materials used.
boss.explain: 文中提到 They must have intentionally bypassed the rigorous quality checks to cut costs (他們一定為了省成本而故意繞過嚴格的品質檢驗)，對應選項 B。

boss.desc: 【短文】HR Announcement: We have been evaluating our current health benefits package for the past six months. The updated dental plan is slated to be launched in January. Employees who missed the open enrollment period must have overlooked the multiple reminder emails sent last week. Q: What is true about the updated dental plan?
options: A. It has already been implemented.
B. It will be introduced at the beginning of the year.
C. It was rejected by the employees.
D. It replaces the mandatory health checkup.
boss.explain: 文中指出 The updated dental plan is slated to be launched in January (預計於一月推出)，故選 B。

boss.desc: 【短文】Policy Update: The travel reimbursement process has been causing frustration among staff members. The finance team is reported to have overhauled the entire system to ensure faster payouts. Staff members who submitted claims last month must have noticed the significantly reduced processing time. Q: What was the main issue with the previous reimbursement process?
options: A. It required too many physical receipts.
B. It paid out in the wrong currency.
C. It was too slow and frustrated the employees.
D. It was only available to senior management.
boss.explain: 文中提到 causing frustration，並說財務團隊徹底改革系統 to ensure faster payouts (以確保更快的撥款)，代表以前的問題是太慢，故選 C。

boss.desc: 【短文】Abstract: Our team has been conducting longitudinal surveys on sleep deprivation among teenagers. The cognitive decline observed in the subjects is hypothesized to have been exacerbated by excessive screen time before bed. Previous studies must have failed to account for the blue light emission from modern smartphones. Q: What factor did previous studies likely miss according to the abstract?
options: A. The average sleep duration of adults.
B. The impact of blue light from modern phones.
C. The dietary habits of the subjects.
D. The academic pressure teenagers face.
boss.explain: 短文最後一句明確指出 Previous studies must have failed to account for the blue light emission from modern smartphones (之前的研究一定沒將現代手機的藍光輻射納入考量)。

boss.desc: 【短文】Abstract Snippet: Scientists have been attempting to synthesize a room-temperature superconductor for decades. The recent breakthrough is widely considered to be a pivotal moment in electrical engineering. The lead researcher must have utilized a completely novel crystalline structure, as traditional models consistently failed. Q: How does the recent breakthrough differ from past attempts?
options: A. It took less time to achieve.
B. It relied on traditional, proven models.
C. It likely used a new structural approach.
D. It was accidental and unplanned.
boss.explain: 文中提到 lead researcher must have utilized a completely novel crystalline structure (一定使用了一種全新的晶體結構)，故選 C。

boss.desc: 【短文】Travel Insight: The hospitality industry has been adapting to the rise of "bleisure" travel—combining business with leisure. Many luxury resorts are reported to have upgraded their business centers to accommodate remote workers. Hotel managers must have realized that free Wi-Fi is no longer sufficient to attract this new demographic. Q: What is the main reason luxury resorts are upgrading their facilities?
options: A. To comply with new safety regulations.
B. To meet the needs of travelers mixing work and vacation.
C. To host international political summits.
D. To reduce their overall energy consumption.
boss.explain: 文章首句定義 bleisure 為 combining business with leisure，並提到度假村升級商務中心以 accommodate remote workers (容納遠端工作者)，故選 B。

boss.desc: 【短文】Industry Report: Sustainable tourism has been gaining immense traction among millennials. The carbon footprint of commercial flights is acknowledged to be a major concern for these environmentally conscious travelers. Airlines must have noticed this trend, as many are now offering carbon offset programs at checkout. Q: How are airlines responding to the new trend among millennial travelers?
options: A. By stopping all international flights.
B. By offering cheaper tickets to millennials.
C. By providing options to neutralize travel emissions.
D. By forcing passengers to plant trees.
boss.explain: 文中提到 airlines ... are now offering carbon offset programs (航空公司現在提供碳補償計畫)，即提供中和碳排的選項 (neutralize travel emissions)。

boss.desc: 【短文】Book Review: The author has been weaving intricate political allegories into her fantasy worlds for years. Her latest work is said to have been inspired by the European industrial revolution. Readers familiar with her style must have quickly identified the parallels between the fictional empire and 19th-century Britain. Q: What is the primary inspiration for the author's latest book?
options: A. The author's personal childhood memories.
B. The industrial revolution in Europe.
C. A recent political scandal in modern Britain.
D. Classical Greek mythology.
boss.explain: 文中直接說明 Her latest work is said to have been inspired by the European industrial revolution (據說靈感來自歐洲工業革命)。

boss.desc: 【短文】Critique: Throughout the memoir, the writer has been attempting to justify his controversial political decisions. However, his account is proven to have omitted several key events that contradict his narrative. He must have assumed that his audience would not fact-check his highly biased timeline. Q: What is the main criticism of the memoir?
options: A. It deliberately leaves out information that goes against the writer's views.
B. It is too long and difficult to understand.
C. It focuses too much on the writer's personal life.
D. It was published without the publisher's consent.
boss.explain: 文中批評 omitted several key events that contradict his narrative (遺漏了數個與其敘述矛盾的關鍵事件)，即故意略過不利資訊，故選 A。

boss.desc: 【綜合】The ancient manuscript, which ___ in a forgotten monastery, is currently being authenticated. The monks who preserved it ___ extraordinary measures to protect it from moisture.
options: A. is believed to be found / should take
B. is believed to have been found / must have taken
C. believes to find / must take
D. believed to have found / should have taken
boss.explain: 第一格：手稿「被發現」發生在過去，用 is believed to have been found。第二格：推測過去僧侶「一定採取了」保護措施，用 must have taken。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
boss.speak: Experts have been predicting a remarkably sharp downturn in the automotive manufacturing sector.
options: A. 專家們必須立刻預防汽車製造業的急劇衰退。
B. 汽車製造業的衰退一定是被專家們準確預測到了。
C. 專家們一直在預測汽車製造業將出現顯著的急劇衰退。
D. 汽車製造業預期將經歷一場前所未見的增長。
boss.explain: 英文原句：Experts have been predicting a remarkably sharp downturn in the automotive manufacturing sector. (專家們一直在預測汽車製造業將出現顯著的急劇衰退。) downturn 指經濟衰退、下降趨勢。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
boss.speak: The sudden political turmoil must have destabilized the regional currency significantly.
options: A. 政治動盪一直在破壞區域貨幣的穩定性。
B. 突如其來的政治動盪一定嚴重破壞了區域貨幣的穩定。
C. 區域貨幣的貶值預期將引發政治動盪。
D. 必須有政治動盪才能促成貨幣的重大改革。
boss.explain: 英文原句：The sudden political turmoil must have destabilized the regional currency significantly. (突如其來的政治動盪一定嚴重破壞了區域貨幣的穩定。) destabilize 使動搖、破壞穩定。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
boss.speak: The unprecedented inflation rate is widely believed to have been fueled by irresponsible speculative trading.
options: A. 史無前例的通貨膨脹一直在助長投機交易的發生。
B. 投機交易必須對這場史無前例的通貨膨脹負責。
C. 普遍認為這場史無前例的通膨率是由不負責任的投機交易推波助瀾所致。
D. 廣大的民眾預期投機交易將導致更嚴重的通貨膨脹。
boss.explain: 英文原句：The unprecedented inflation rate is widely believed to have been fueled by irresponsible speculative trading. (普遍認為這場史無前例的通膨率是由不負責任的投機交易推波助瀾所致。) is believed to have been fueled by 為進階複雜被動句型。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
boss.speak: The diplomatic ties between the two rival nations must have deteriorated substantially over the winter.
options: A. 兩大敵對國家的外交關係在整個冬天一定已經大幅惡化了。
B. 兩國的外交關係一直在冬天期間不斷惡化。
C. 這兩個國家必須在冬天前修復他們的外交關係。
D. 兩國預期會在冬季期間展開實質的外交談判。
boss.explain: 英文原句：The diplomatic ties between the two rival nations must have deteriorated substantially over the winter. (兩大敵對國家的外交關係在整個冬天一定已經大幅惡化了。) deteriorate 惡化、變壞。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
boss.speak: The highly controversial legislation has been facing fierce resistance from numerous grassroots organizations.
options: A. 充滿爭議的法案一定是被基層組織給強烈抵制了。
B. 充滿爭議的法案預期將被基層組織強烈反對。
C. 基層組織必須對這項充滿爭議的法案展開抵制。
D. 這項極具爭議的法案一直面臨來自眾多基層組織的強烈抵抗。
boss.explain: 英文原句：The highly controversial legislation has been facing fierce resistance from numerous grassroots organizations. (這項極具爭議的法案一直面臨來自眾多基層組織的強烈抵抗。) legislation 法規、法案；grassroots 基層的。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
boss.speak: The mayor's ambitious urban renewal plan is highly likely to be scrutinized by the opposition party.
options: A. 廣受反對黨審查的都市更新計畫一定是市長提議的。
B. 市長野心勃勃的都市更新計畫極有可能會受到反對黨的嚴格審查。
C. 反對黨一直在嚴厲審查市長的都市更新計畫。
D. 市長必須親自審查反對黨提出的都市更新計畫。
boss.explain: 英文原句：The mayor's ambitious urban renewal plan is highly likely to be scrutinized by the opposition party. (市長野心勃勃的都市更新計畫極有可能會受到反對黨的嚴格審查。) scrutinize 仔細審查。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
boss.speak: We have been trying to decipher the underlying economic implications of the newly announced tariffs.
options: A. 新宣布的關稅一定隱藏了某些經濟意圖。
B. 我們必須解讀新關稅所帶來的潛在影響。
C. 我們一直在試圖解讀新宣布的關稅背後隱含的經濟影響。
D. 新關稅的經濟影響預計將由我們來進行解讀。
boss.explain: 英文原句：We have been trying to decipher the underlying economic implications of the newly announced tariffs. (我們一直在試圖解讀新宣布的關稅背後隱含的經濟影響。) decipher 解讀、破譯；implication 影響、暗指。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
boss.speak: The whistle-blower's explosive allegations must have triggered an immediate federal probe.
options: A. 聯邦調查局一直在針對吹哨者的指控進行調查。
B. 吹哨者的爆炸性指控一定觸發了立即的聯邦調查。
C. 吹哨者必須提出指控才能觸發聯邦調查。
D. 聯邦調查預計會揭露吹哨者的爆炸性指控。
boss.explain: 英文原句：The whistle-blower's explosive allegations must have triggered an immediate federal probe. (吹哨者的爆炸性指控一定觸發了立即的聯邦調查。) allegation 指控；probe 調查。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
boss.speak: A substantial financial rescue package is anticipated to be unveiled to prevent a total market collapse.
options: A. 為了防止市場全面崩潰，預計將會公布一項大規模的金融救援方案。
B. 一項大規模的救援方案一定已經為了防止市場崩潰而公布了。
C. 政府必須公布金融救援方案，因為市場一直在崩潰。
D. 救援方案的公布預計將會導致金融市場的全面崩潰。
boss.explain: 英文原句：A substantial financial rescue package is anticipated to be unveiled to prevent a total market collapse. (為了防止市場全面崩潰，預計將會公布一項大規模的金融救援方案。) unveil 揭幕、公布。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
boss.speak: The investigative journalists have been uncovering a complex web of corporate espionage all year.
options: A. 調查記者一定是在今年揭露了商業間諜的網路。
B. 企業間諜活動預期將被調查記者全面揭露。
C. 商業間諜網路必須由調查記者來進行揭發。
D. 調查記者一整年來一直在揭露錯綜複雜的企業間諜網。
boss.explain: 英文原句：The investigative journalists have been uncovering a complex web of corporate espionage all year. (調查記者一整年來一直在揭露錯綜複雜的企業間諜網。) espionage 間諜活動。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
boss.speak: The sudden collapse of the banking giant must have sent shockwaves through the global economy.
options: A. 銀行巨頭的突然倒閉一定在世界經濟中引發了震盪。
B. 全球經濟的震盪一直在導致銀行巨頭的倒閉。
C. 銀行巨頭必須倒閉才能對全球經濟產生影響。
D. 銀行巨頭的倒閉預計將對全球經濟造成衝擊。
boss.explain: 英文原句：The sudden collapse of the banking giant must have sent shockwaves through the global economy. (銀行巨頭的突然倒閉一定在世界經濟中引發了震盪。) send shockwaves 引起震動、震撼。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
boss.speak: The fragile ceasefire agreement is widely reported to have been violated multiple times by both factions.
options: A. 雙方派系一直在違反那份脆弱的停火協議。
B. 停火協議必須被雙方嚴格遵守，否則會被違反。
C. 據廣泛報導，那份脆弱的停火協議已被雙方派系多次違反。
D. 雙方派系一定已經違反了那份脆弱的停火協議。
boss.explain: 英文原句：The fragile ceasefire agreement is widely reported to have been violated multiple times by both factions. (據廣泛報導，那份脆弱的停火協議已被雙方派系多次違反。) is reported to have been V-p.p. 為進階被動型態，表示據報導過去已被...

boss.desc: 【綜合語法】The commodity prices ___ wildly this month. Speculators are thought ___ artificial shortages to drive up the value.
options: A. fluctuate / to create
B. have been fluctuating / to have created
C. are fluctuating / creating
D. fluctuated / created
boss.explain: 前半句強調這個月以來持續的波動，用 have been fluctuating；後半句表示投機客被認為「已經製造了」人為短缺，用 to have created。

boss.desc: 【短文】Market Analysis: Tech stocks have been taking a hit lately. The sudden crash of Apex Inc. is alleged to have been orchestrated by massive institutional sell-offs. Retail investors, caught off guard, must have lost millions overnight. The market volatility highlights the need for a diversified ___ to absorb such sudden shocks. Q: Which word best completes the text?
options: A. mandate
B. portfolio
C. allegation
D. backlash
boss.explain: 投資人需要一個多樣化的「投資組合 (portfolio)」來吸收市場衝擊。mandate 為命令，allegation 為指控。

boss.desc: 【綜合語法】Local authorities ___ the factory's wastewater discharge for weeks. The toxic chemicals are confirmed ___ heavy damage to the nearby wetlands.
options: A. have been tracking / to have caused
B. tracked / to cause
C. are tracking / causing
D. had tracked / to have been caused
boss.explain: 第一格表示持續數週的追蹤 (have been tracking)。第二格表示化學物質被確認「已經造成」損害，主動語態完成式不定詞 (to have caused)。

boss.desc: 【短文】Ecological Update: Activists have been protesting the new mining mandate for over a month. The excavation process is argued to have irreparably depleted the underground aquifers. The local government must have prioritized short-term economic gains over long-term sustainability. Q: What is the main criticism against the local government?
options: A. They failed to pay the activists.
B. They valued quick money over the environment.
C. They ordered the aquifers to be filled.
D. They stopped the mining mandate.
boss.explain: 文中提到政府一定把短期經濟利益看得比長期永續性更重要 (prioritized short-term economic gains over long-term sustainability)，選項 B 最符合。

boss.desc: 【短文】Compliance Memo: All manufacturing branches have been struggling to meet the new emission targets. The old ventilation systems are known to have continuously leaked hazardous gases. The facility managers must have delayed the necessary upgrades to avoid budget overruns. Now, they must immediately ___ the old systems and install compliant ones. Q: Which word fits the blank best?
options: A. dismantle
B. liquidate
C. speculate
D. fluctuate
boss.explain: 為了升級，必須「拆除 (dismantle)」舊系統並安裝合規的新系統。liquidate 為清算資產，speculate 為投機。

boss.desc: 【綜合語法】Customers ___ of faulty wiring in the blenders since May. The severe overheating is suspected ___ several kitchen fires last week.
options: A. complain / to cause
B. have been complaining / to have caused
C. complained / causing
D. had complained / to be caused
boss.explain: 第一格用現在完成進行式表示自五月以來持續的抱怨；第二格用 to have caused 表示「過去被懷疑造成了火災」。

boss.desc: 【短文】Automotive Recall: We have been investigating the spontaneous airbag deployments in our 2025 sedans. The sensors are discovered to have been compromised by a substandard microchip. The chip supplier must have skipped the rigorous extreme-temperature testing phase. Vehicle owners are advised to avoid driving until the repair is completed. Q: What is the root cause of the airbag issue?
options: A. Extreme temperatures
B. A low-quality microchip
C. Aggressive driving
D. Expired sensors
boss.explain: 文中指出感測器因為一個劣質微晶片 (substandard microchip) 而出現問題。

boss.desc: 【綜合語法】Researchers ___ the monkeys' reactions to mirror reflections. The cognitive breakthrough is reported ___ earlier than initially predicted.
options: A. have been observing / to have occurred
B. observe / to occur
C. are observing / occurring
D. observed / to have been occurred
boss.explain: 研究員一直持續觀察 (have been observing)；認知突破據報導發生得比預期早，用 to have occurred (occur 不用被動)。

boss.desc: 【短文】Behavioral Study: We have been analyzing the correlation between sleep deprivation and risk-taking. Subjects lacking sleep are shown to have deviated significantly from logical decision-making models. They must have relied heavily on emotional impulses rather than rational thought. Q: How did sleep-deprived subjects make decisions?
options: A. Through careful logical deduction.
B. By following strict rational models.
C. Based mostly on emotional impulses.
D. By avoiding any risk-taking behavior.
boss.explain: 文章提到他們一定非常依賴情緒衝動 (relied heavily on emotional impulses)。

boss.desc: 【綜合語法】The CEO's questionable tax records ___ intense public scrutiny. The missing documents are assumed ___ deliberately destroyed before the audit.
options: A. draw / to be
B. have been drawing / to have been
C. are drawing / having been
D. drew / to have
boss.explain: 一直在引來公眾審視用 have been drawing；文件被假設「已經被銷毀」，用完成式被動不定詞 to have been destroyed。

boss.desc: 【短文】Corporate Crisis Press Release: Our legal team has been addressing the recent allegations of corporate espionage. The stolen data is confirmed to have been sold to a rival firm on the dark web. The former head of IT must have orchestrated the breach, as he had the highest level of clearance. We are working closely with cyber authorities. Q: Who is believed to be responsible for the data breach?
options: A. The cyber authorities
B. The legal team
C. A rival firm
D. The former head of IT
boss.explain: 文中明確指出「The former head of IT must have orchestrated the breach」(前IT主管一定策劃了這起外洩)。

boss.desc: 【短文】Internal Leak: Employees have been expressing outrage over the hidden executive bonuses. The board's attempt to cover up the payments is proven to have worsened the public ___. They must have underestimated the staff's demand for transparency and accountability. Q: Which word fits the blank best?
options: A. backlash
B. compliance
C. dividend
D. portfolio
boss.explain: 董事會掩蓋獎金的行為加劇了公眾的「強烈反彈 (backlash)」。
